courses.title: 晶圓研磨與拋光
courses.summary: 從鋸切晶圓的厚度與損傷開始，建立研磨、鏡面拋光、清潔與放行之間的證據鏈。
courses.summaryEn: Build an evidence chain from thickness and saw damage through lapping, mirror polishing, cleaning and release.

stages.title: 來料與幾何基準
stages.description: 先辨認材料狀態與量測定義，再規劃可用的去除量。
stages.descriptionEn: Identify material condition and measurement definitions before allocating removal.

steps.title: 辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界
steps.titleEn: Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP
steps.objective: 界定本批晶圓的材料層與後續用途。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the material stack and intended next process.
steps.instruction: 畫出鋸切裸矽與已有金屬圖案晶圓的兩種截面；在各截面標記可移除材料、保留材料及下一站需要的表面。比較兩者為何不能共用同一終點判據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw cross-sections of sawn bare silicon and a patterned metal wafer. Mark removable and retained material and the surface required next. Compare why the two need different endpoint criteria.
steps.observation: 觀察「厚度達標」與「保留薄膜達標」是否指向不同的量測。
steps.observationEn: Notice whether target wafer thickness and target remaining film require different measurements.
steps.failure: 若把金屬 CMP 的選擇性直接當成裸矽拋光規格，先退回材料清單重新界定。
steps.failureEn: If metal-CMP selectivity is treated as a bare-silicon specification, revisit the material inventory.
steps.check: 交出兩張截面並為每張指定一項厚度和一項表面驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit both cross-sections with one thickness and one surface check for each.

knowledge.title: 加工對象
knowledge.text: 裸矽整備處理基板本體；薄膜 CMP 還須保護已形成的材料與圖案。
knowledge.textEn: Bare-wafer finishing shapes the substrate; film CMP must also preserve existing layers and patterns.

knowledge.title: 終點的意義
knowledge.text: 停止條件取決於下一製程需求，不能只以外觀發亮決定。
knowledge.textEn: Stopping depends on the next process, not just a shiny appearance.

quiz.question: 兩片晶圓同樣發亮，為何仍不能用相同終點放行？
quiz.questionEn: Why can two equally shiny wafers require different release endpoints?
options: 它們需要保留的材料和量測對象不同。
兩種終點都只由晶圓直徑決定。
只需反轉研磨方向，便可共用剩餘材料要求。
optionsEn: They retain different materials and require different measurements.
Both endpoints depend only on wafer diameter.
Reversing polishing direction makes remaining-material requirements interchangeable.
quiz.explanation: 它們需要保留的材料和量測對象不同。 裸矽整備處理基板本體；薄膜 CMP 還須保護已形成的材料與圖案。
quiz.explanationEn: They retain different materials and require different measurements. Bare-wafer finishing shapes the substrate; film CMP must also preserve existing layers and patterns.

steps.title: 建立厚度、彎曲與粗糙度量測圖
steps.titleEn: Map thickness, bow and roughness
steps.objective: 把不同尺度的表面問題分開記錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Record surface problems at distinct spatial scales.
steps.instruction: 在自行繪製的九點厚度表填入假設值並註明單位，計算最大與最小差值；另畫整片彎曲輪廓和局部粗糙度截線，避免把三種圖合成單一分數。
steps.instructionEn: Enter labeled hypothetical values in a nine-point thickness table and compute the maximum-minus-minimum difference. Separately sketch whole-wafer bow and local roughness rather than merging them into one score.
steps.observation: 比較厚度一致但彎曲的晶圓，以及不彎曲但厚度不均的晶圓。
steps.observationEn: Compare a uniformly thick bowed wafer with a flat-looking wafer of uneven thickness.
steps.failure: 若換夾持方式便改變結果，記錄支撐條件；不要把受力展平當成本體已修正。
steps.failureEn: If support changes the result, record the fixture condition; forced flattening is not permanent correction.
steps.check: 清楚標明厚度差、整體形狀和局部表面三種證據的量測範圍。
steps.checkEn: Label the measurement extent of thickness variation, overall shape and local surface texture.

knowledge.title: 空間尺度
knowledge.text: 平行度、整體形狀與局部粗糙度回答不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Parallelism, overall shape and local roughness answer different questions.

knowledge.title: 量測基準
knowledge.text: 夾持狀態、取樣位置和邊緣排除區須隨結果保存。
knowledge.textEn: Support condition, sampling positions and edge exclusion belong with the result.

quiz.question: 局部粗糙度降低，能否直接證明全片厚度更均勻？
quiz.questionEn: Does lower local roughness prove improved full-wafer thickness uniformity?
options: 能，局部粗糙度就等於全片平行度。
不能，還需要厚度分布量測。
能，固定放大倍率已足以取代厚度取樣。
optionsEn: Yes; local roughness is the same as full-wafer parallelism.
No; a thickness map is still required.
Yes; fixed magnification replaces thickness sampling.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需要厚度分布量測。 平行度、整體形狀與局部粗糙度回答不同問題。
quiz.explanationEn: No; a thickness map is still required. Parallelism, overall shape and local roughness answer different questions.

steps.title: 分配鋸切後的材料去除預算
steps.titleEn: Allocate removal after slicing
steps.objective: 在厚度限制內保留後續整備的餘量。
steps.objectiveEn: Reserve finishing allowance within the thickness constraint.
steps.instruction: 用紙上厚度帳本列出來料、研磨後、損傷去除後與拋光後四個狀態；自行設定教學數值並逐站相減，檢查最後仍留有修整餘量。
steps.instructionEn: Build a paper thickness ledger for incoming, lapped, damage-removed and polished states. Use explicitly hypothetical values, subtract each allowance and check that finishing margin remains.
steps.observation: 比較平均厚度足夠但局部最薄點已不足的情況。
steps.observationEn: Compare an acceptable average thickness with an already insufficient local minimum.
steps.failure: 若預算只用平均值，可能忽略最薄區；回到來料地圖調整分配。
steps.failureEn: An average-only budget can hide a thin region; revise the allocation using the incoming map.
steps.check: 每一站的移除量與最薄位置均可追溯，且沒有負的剩餘餘量。
steps.checkEn: Trace every removal allocation and the thinnest location, with no negative remaining allowance.

knowledge.title: 去除不可逆
knowledge.text: 後段不能靠拋光補回已移除的矽。
knowledge.textEn: Later polishing cannot restore silicon already removed.

knowledge.title: 最薄區控制
knowledge.text: 放行需考慮局部限制，平均值只能作整體摘要。
knowledge.textEn: Local limits matter for release; the average is only a summary.

quiz.question: 平均厚度尚可，但一區已低於最終要求，應如何判斷？
quiz.questionEn: The average is acceptable but one region is below the final requirement. What follows?
options: 只要中心點達標，其他位置可用平均值代替。
繼續全片均勻去除，直到最薄區回到厚度要求。
不能以平均值掩蓋局部不足，需重新判定可加工性。
optionsEn: If the center passes, other locations may be replaced by the average.
Continue uniform removal until the thinnest region returns to the required thickness.
Reassess processability; the average cannot hide the local shortfall.
quiz.explanation: 不能以平均值掩蓋局部不足，需重新判定可加工性。 後段不能靠拋光補回已移除的矽。
quiz.explanationEn: Reassess processability; the average cannot hide the local shortfall. Later polishing cannot restore silicon already removed.

steps.title: 檢查邊緣完整性與搬運接觸
steps.titleEn: Inspect edge integrity and handling contact
steps.objective: 辨認可能形成碎屑或後續破片的邊緣狀況。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize edge conditions that can generate debris or later fracture.
steps.instruction: 在晶圓圓周示意圖標出缺角、裂紋與正常倒角，另畫載具接觸位置。比較缺陷是否靠近支撐點；只制定影像複查與隔離決策，不實作破壞試驗。
steps.instructionEn: Mark chips, cracks and normal bevels on an edge diagram, then add carrier contact locations. Compare defects with support points and define image review or quarantine decisions without destructive testing.
steps.observation: 注意「平滑倒角」與不規則缺口的形狀差異，以及缺口附近的散落粒子。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish a smooth bevel from an irregular chip and look for nearby debris.
steps.failure: 把正常倒角誤判為缺角會造成誤剔除；只看中心表面則可能漏掉裂紋。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking a bevel for a chip causes false rejects; viewing only the center can miss cracks.
steps.check: 缺陷紀錄包含圓周位置、形貌與處置理由，而非只有合格勾選。
steps.checkEn: Record edge position, morphology and disposition reasoning rather than a pass check alone.

knowledge.title: 邊緣應力
knowledge.text: 邊緣形貌影響接觸與應力集中，也可能成為粒子來源。
knowledge.textEn: Edge geometry influences contact and stress concentration and can become a particle source.

knowledge.title: 缺陷定位
knowledge.text: 同一方位重複出現缺口可提示搬運或載具接觸問題。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated chips at the same orientation can suggest a handling or carrier-contact issue.

quiz.question: 缺口總在同一載具接觸附近出現，優先比較什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Chips repeatedly occur near one carrier contact. What should be compared first?
options: 接觸位置與缺陷方位的關聯。
僅比較中心粗糙度，因為邊緣缺陷一定來自中心。
直接歸因於來料批次，不核對載具方位。
optionsEn: The relationship between contact position and defect orientation.
Compare center roughness only, assuming every edge defect originates at the center.
Attribute it to incoming lots without checking carrier orientation.
quiz.explanation: 接觸位置與缺陷方位的關聯。 邊緣形貌影響接觸與應力集中，也可能成為粒子來源。
quiz.explanationEn: The relationship between contact position and defect orientation. Edge geometry influences contact and stress concentration and can become a particle source.

stages.title: 研磨與表面整備
stages.description: 比較厚度修正、邊緣完整性與表面損傷，避免把粗加工當鏡面加工。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate thickness correction, edge integrity and damage removal from mirror finishing.

steps.title: 推演雙面研磨的厚度修正
steps.titleEn: Model thickness correction during lapping
steps.objective: 理解兩面去除如何改善厚度與平行度。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how removal from both faces changes thickness and parallelism.
steps.instruction: 在截面模型將上、下研磨面分別標色，畫出厚端與薄端的去除趨勢。比較均勻去除和偏一側去除兩種假設，不把壓力示意值當作設備設定。
steps.instructionEn: Color the upper and lower lapping interfaces in a section model. Sketch removal trends at thick and thin regions and compare uniform versus one-sided removal assumptions without turning schematic pressure into machine settings.
steps.observation: 觀察兩面總去除量相同時，偏斜是否仍可能殘留。
steps.observationEn: Check whether tilt can remain even when total removal from both faces is equal.
steps.failure: 只追求總去除量會漏掉局部平行度；需返回厚度地圖，而非只看加工時間。
steps.failureEn: Total removal alone misses local parallelism; return to the thickness map rather than processing time.
steps.check: 說明一個厚度改善但平行度未改善的案例。
steps.checkEn: Explain a case where thickness improves but parallelism does not.

knowledge.title: 相對去除
knowledge.text: 厚度與兩面相對形狀由材料去除的空間分布共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness and relative face shape depend on the spatial distribution of removal.

knowledge.title: 時間不是品質
knowledge.text: 相同時間不保證相同去除分布，工具與接觸狀態也需追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: Equal time does not guarantee equal removal distribution; tool and contact condition also matter.

quiz.question: 研磨時間相同的兩批厚度分布不同，哪種說法較合理？
quiz.questionEn: Two equally timed lots have different thickness maps. Which explanation is reasonable?
options: 相同時間必須對應相同去除，應先排除所有工具因素。
接觸與去除分布可能不同。
只要平均來料厚度相同，局部接觸就必然相同。
optionsEn: Equal time requires equal removal, so all tool factors should be excluded.
Contact and removal distributions may differ.
Equal incoming average thickness guarantees identical local contact.
quiz.explanation: 接觸與去除分布可能不同。 厚度與兩面相對形狀由材料去除的空間分布共同決定。
quiz.explanationEn: Contact and removal distributions may differ. Thickness and relative face shape depend on the spatial distribution of removal.

steps.title: 區分機械損傷去除與鏡面外觀
steps.titleEn: Separate damage removal from mirror appearance
steps.objective: 把次表面損傷列為獨立整備問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Treat subsurface damage as a separate preparation concern.
steps.instruction: 在鋸切與研磨後的剖面下方加上受損層，再畫去除後剖面。對照來源的加工順序，說明為何損傷整備不能僅由一張反光照片驗證；不配置蝕刻化學品。
steps.instructionEn: Add a damaged layer beneath sawn and lapped surfaces, then draw the section after its removal. Use the referenced sequence to explain why a reflective photograph cannot verify damage preparation; do not mix etchants.
steps.observation: 觀察外觀粗糙度和損傷深度是否被誤畫為同一條界線。
steps.observationEn: Check whether surface roughness and damage depth have been incorrectly represented as the same boundary.
steps.failure: 若以光澤代替損傷證據，列出仍未知的部分並保留待驗證狀態。
steps.failureEn: If gloss substitutes for damage evidence, list what remains unknown and keep the status unverified.
steps.check: 在流程圖中標出損傷來源、去除目的及後續證據，沒有宣稱鏡面等於無損傷。
steps.checkEn: Mark the damage source, removal purpose and later evidence without equating a mirror finish with no damage.

knowledge.title: 次表面層
knowledge.text: 機械加工的影響可延伸到可見表面以下。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical processing can affect material below the visible surface.

knowledge.title: 證據範圍
knowledge.text: 外觀影像能說明可見缺陷，不能單獨涵蓋所有材料狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Appearance images show visible defects but cannot alone establish every material condition.

quiz.question: 晶圓很亮但沒有損傷去除紀錄，能否直接宣告無損傷？
quiz.questionEn: A wafer is shiny but lacks damage-removal evidence. Can it be declared damage-free?
options: 能，鏡面粗糙度已完整代表次表面狀態。
能，研磨後平均厚度合格即代表所有損傷去除。
不能，外觀與材料損傷需要不同證據。
optionsEn: Yes; mirror-surface roughness completely represents subsurface condition.
Yes; acceptable average thickness after lapping proves all damage was removed.
No; appearance and material damage require different evidence.
quiz.explanation: 不能，外觀與材料損傷需要不同證據。 機械加工的影響可延伸到可見表面以下。
quiz.explanationEn: No; appearance and material damage require different evidence. Mechanical processing can affect material below the visible surface.

steps.title: 分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動
steps.titleEn: Separate pad, slurry and relative motion
steps.objective: 建立化學與機械作用共同去除材料的模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Model removal as coupled chemical and mechanical action.
steps.instruction: 畫出晶圓、研磨墊與漿料三個界面，逐一改變示意中的接觸、供液或相對運動；在紙上預測哪種改變會造成去除變慢或局部不均。
steps.instructionEn: Draw wafer, pad and slurry interfaces. Change contact, liquid supply or relative motion one at a time in the sketch and predict slower removal or local nonuniformity.
steps.observation: 比較材料容易反應但接觸不良，以及接觸充分但漿料狀態不合適的兩種情境。
steps.observationEn: Compare a reactive surface with poor contact against good contact with unsuitable slurry condition.
steps.failure: 把所有變化歸因於轉速會忽略墊面或漿料；重新建立一因一變的比較。
steps.failureEn: Attributing every change to speed ignores the pad or slurry; restore a one-factor comparison.
steps.check: 因果圖同時包含表面反應、接觸與帶走材料三條路徑。
steps.checkEn: Include surface reaction, contact and material removal pathways in the causal diagram.

knowledge.title: 耦合作用
knowledge.text: CMP 同時依靠化學環境與機械接觸，不能僅視為乾磨。
knowledge.textEn: CMP couples a chemical environment with mechanical contact; it is not simply dry abrasion.

knowledge.title: 變因隔離
knowledge.text: 一次比較一個變因，才容易判別局部不均的來源。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing one variable at a time helps identify the origin of nonuniformity.

quiz.question: 為何不能只提高轉速來解決每種拋光缺陷？
quiz.questionEn: Why is increasing speed not a universal polishing fix?
options: 缺陷也可能來自接觸、墊面或漿料條件。
提高轉速會自動保持所有區域的接觸壓力一致。
所有缺陷都是去除量不足，延長加工即可解決。
optionsEn: Defects can also arise from contact, pad condition or slurry.
Higher speed automatically equalizes pressure in every region.
Every defect is insufficient removal and can be fixed by longer processing.
quiz.explanation: 缺陷也可能來自接觸、墊面或漿料條件。 CMP 同時依靠化學環境與機械接觸，不能僅視為乾磨。
quiz.explanationEn: Defects can also arise from contact, pad condition or slurry. CMP couples a chemical environment with mechanical contact; it is not simply dry abrasion.

steps.title: 追蹤工具狀態與批次漂移
steps.titleEn: Track tool condition and lot drift
steps.objective: 把工具變化與晶圓差異分開比較。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate tool changes from wafer-to-wafer differences.
steps.instruction: 自行建立三批假設紀錄，包含初始厚度、去除量與工具使用順序。將結果按時間與來料條件分別排序，判斷趨勢更像來料偏移還是工具狀態漂移。
steps.instructionEn: Create three hypothetical lots with starting thickness, removal and tool-use order. Sort results by time and incoming condition separately to distinguish material shift from tool-condition drift.
steps.observation: 注意是否從某次工具狀態改變後，所有晶圓都出現相似偏移。
steps.observationEn: Look for a common shift across wafers after a tool-condition change.
steps.failure: 混合不同來料規格可能製造假的時間趨勢；先分組再比較。
steps.failureEn: Mixing incoming specifications can create a false time trend; stratify before comparison.
steps.check: 提出一項可區分兩種假說的追加觀察，並保留批次識別。
steps.checkEn: Propose an additional observation that distinguishes the hypotheses and retain lot identities.

knowledge.title: 共同原因
knowledge.text: 同一工具狀態可影響多片晶圓，因此需要批次與時間關聯。
knowledge.textEn: A shared tool condition can affect many wafers, making lot and time associations useful.

knowledge.title: 分組比較
knowledge.text: 相似來料的前後比較，比混合所有晶圓平均值更容易解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Before-and-after comparisons of similar inputs are easier to interpret than a mixed average.

quiz.question: 發現時間趨勢前，為何先確認來料規格一致？
quiz.questionEn: Why check comparable incoming specifications before interpreting a time trend?
options: 因為不同來料只影響產量，從不影響去除結果。
避免把材料差異誤當成工具漂移。
因為分組後便不需要保留工具時間順序。
optionsEn: Different incoming material affects output quantity but never removal results.
To avoid mistaking material differences for tool drift.
Stratification eliminates the need to retain tool-use order.
quiz.explanation: 避免把材料差異誤當成工具漂移。 同一工具狀態可影響多片晶圓，因此需要批次與時間關聯。
quiz.explanationEn: To avoid mistaking material differences for tool drift. A shared tool condition can affect many wafers, making lot and time associations useful.

stages.title: 拋光與驗證
stages.description: 以分布、缺陷與污染證據共同判定是否可交付下一製程。
stages.descriptionEn: Combine spatial profiles, defects and contamination evidence before release.

steps.title: 評估中心與邊緣去除分布
steps.titleEn: Evaluate center-to-edge removal
steps.objective: 以徑向地圖識別過度與不足去除。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify over-removal and under-removal on a radial map.
steps.instruction: 將自己設定的拋光前後九點厚度相減，畫成中心、過渡區和邊緣三區。先描述哪區去除較多，再提出壓力或接觸假說；不替未知設備填入壓力數值。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract your hypothetical before-and-after nine-point maps and group removal into center, transition and edge. Describe the pattern before proposing pressure or contact hypotheses; do not invent machine pressures.
steps.observation: 平均去除量相同的兩片，可能有相反的中心與邊緣分布。
steps.observationEn: Equal average removal can hide opposite center-to-edge patterns.
steps.failure: 若只量中心，就無法確認邊緣過拋；補上邊緣取樣並標明排除範圍。
steps.failureEn: Center-only sampling misses edge overpolish; add edge sampling and label exclusions.
steps.check: 交出分區去除圖及一個可被後續量測推翻的假說。
steps.checkEn: Submit a zonal removal map and a hypothesis that later measurements could disprove.

knowledge.title: 分布回授
knowledge.text: 局部去除差異需要空間回授，單一平均厚度不足。
knowledge.textEn: Local removal differences need spatial feedback; one average thickness is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 假說與觀察
knowledge.text: 「邊緣較薄」是觀察；「接觸壓力造成」仍需驗證。
knowledge.textEn: A thinner edge is an observation; a contact-pressure explanation still needs testing.

quiz.question: 平均去除達標但邊緣明顯過薄，應如何放行？
quiz.questionEn: Average removal meets target but the edge is clearly too thin. How should release be judged?
options: 依平均值放行，局部不足可由中心厚度補償。
只重新定義排除區，不檢查這是否符合原規格。
依局部規格重新判定，不能只以平均值放行。
optionsEn: Release by the average; center thickness compensates for a local deficit.
Redefine the excluded region without checking the original specification.
Reassess local specifications rather than release by the average alone.
quiz.explanation: 依局部規格重新判定，不能只以平均值放行。 局部去除差異需要空間回授，單一平均厚度不足。
quiz.explanationEn: Reassess local specifications rather than release by the average alone. Local removal differences need spatial feedback; one average thickness is insufficient.

steps.title: 建立拋光終點與過拋辨識
steps.titleEn: Define a polishing endpoint
steps.objective: 用目標剩餘量和缺陷條件共同決定停止。
steps.objectiveEn: Combine remaining-material targets and defect conditions when deciding to stop.
steps.instruction: 在紙上比較提早停止、剛好達標及持續去除三個情境。為每一情境記錄剩餘厚度、均勻度和表面狀態；說明為何延長時間不能無限改善品質。
steps.instructionEn: Compare early stopping, target completion and continued removal on paper. Record remaining thickness, uniformity and surface condition for each, explaining why more time cannot improve quality indefinitely.
steps.observation: 觀察缺陷改善與厚度損失可能同時發生，兩者需共同判讀。
steps.observationEn: Observe that defect improvement and thickness loss can occur together and must be interpreted jointly.
steps.failure: 將時間到達視為唯一終點時，工具漂移會被漏掉；要求相應的量測佐證。
steps.failureEn: A time-only endpoint can miss tool drift; require matching measurement evidence.
steps.check: 列出停止條件、超出條件與需要保留的驗證紀錄。
steps.checkEn: List stop criteria, out-of-limit conditions and the verification record to retain.

knowledge.title: 多條件終點
knowledge.text: 終點是符合要求的狀態，不只是計時器結束。
knowledge.textEn: An endpoint is a required state, not merely the end of a timer.

knowledge.title: 過拋代價
knowledge.text: 額外去除可能消耗幾何餘量，不能假定越久越好。
knowledge.textEn: Extra removal can consume geometric margin; longer is not automatically better.

quiz.question: 延長拋光使局部表面變好，卻低於厚度下限，結果為何？
quiz.questionEn: Longer polishing improves a local surface but violates minimum thickness. What is the result?
options: 仍不符合整體放行要求。
表面要求優先時，厚度下限便自動失效。
用較低的平均去除率重算報告，就可視為沒有超限。
optionsEn: It still fails the combined release requirements.
Giving surface quality priority automatically removes the thickness limit.
Recalculate the report with a lower average removal rate to erase the violation.
quiz.explanation: 仍不符合整體放行要求。 終點是符合要求的狀態，不只是計時器結束。
quiz.explanationEn: It still fails the combined release requirements. An endpoint is a required state, not merely the end of a timer.

steps.title: 追蹤拋光後粒子與再污染
steps.titleEn: Trace particles and recontamination
steps.objective: 區分去除缺陷與清潔後新增污染。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish polishing defects from contamination introduced after cleaning.
steps.instruction: 畫出拋光出口、清洗、乾燥與載具四個交接點，為每點建立假設粒子位置圖。比較同一晶圓前後地圖，找出首次出現新粒子的交接位置。
steps.instructionEn: Draw handoffs from polishing to cleaning, drying and carrier storage. Create hypothetical particle maps at each and compare the same wafer over time to locate where new particles first appear.
steps.observation: 查看粒子是否跟著固定方位、液滴痕跡或載具接觸分布出現。
steps.observationEn: Look for patterns tied to orientation, drying marks or carrier contacts.
steps.failure: 最後一張地圖只能證明最終狀態，不能單獨證明哪個站點造成污染。
steps.failureEn: A final map establishes the final state but cannot alone identify the contaminating station.
steps.check: 提出保留污染追溯能力的前後比對方案，不假定清洗必然成功。
steps.checkEn: Propose before-and-after comparisons that preserve traceability without assuming cleaning succeeded.

knowledge.title: 交接污染
knowledge.text: 已拋光表面仍可能在清潔與搬運之間重新受到污染。
knowledge.textEn: A polished surface can be recontaminated during cleaning and handling handoffs.

knowledge.title: 同片追蹤
knowledge.text: 同片同方位的比較有助於區別舊缺陷與新缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing the same wafer and orientation helps distinguish old and new defects.

quiz.question: 如何較有力地判斷污染是否在載具交接後出現？
quiz.questionEn: What better supports a conclusion that contamination appeared after carrier handoff?
options: 比較不同批次的最終平均粒子數即可定位本站責任。
比較同一晶圓交接前後、相同方位的粒子圖。
只查看清洗設備的完成訊號即可排除搬運污染。
optionsEn: Comparing final average particle counts from different lots identifies this station’s responsibility.
Compare aligned particle maps of the same wafer before and after handoff.
A cleaning-complete signal rules out handling contamination.
quiz.explanation: 比較同一晶圓交接前後、相同方位的粒子圖。 已拋光表面仍可能在清潔與搬運之間重新受到污染。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare aligned particle maps of the same wafer before and after handoff. A polished surface can be recontaminated during cleaning and handling handoffs.

steps.title: 整合晶圓放行與異常處置
steps.titleEn: Integrate wafer release and disposition
steps.objective: 用可追溯證據決定放行、複查或隔離。
steps.objectiveEn: Decide release, review or quarantine using traceable evidence.
steps.instruction: 整理前十一項產物，將厚度、形狀、表面缺陷與清潔證據放在同一張放行表。加入一個缺少量測的案例及一個確認超限案例，分別說明下一個行動。
steps.instructionEn: Combine the prior outputs into a release sheet covering thickness, shape, surface defects and cleanliness. Add one missing-measurement case and one confirmed out-of-limit case and assign different next actions.
steps.observation: 確認「尚無證據」沒有被寫成「已證明合格」，不同量測仍保留其基準。
steps.observationEn: Ensure missing evidence is not recorded as demonstrated compliance and each measurement retains its reference.
steps.failure: 若重工會超出剩餘厚度預算，就不能僅因想降低報廢率而批准。
steps.failureEn: Do not authorize rework that exceeds the remaining thickness budget just to reduce rejects.
steps.check: 每個結論都有批次、量測與處置理由，且下一站知道未解問題。
steps.checkEn: Link every conclusion to lot, measurement and disposition reasoning, with unresolved issues visible to the next stage.

knowledge.title: 放行證據鏈
knowledge.text: 產品放行需要相互一致的多項證據，而非挑選最漂亮的一項。
knowledge.textEn: Release needs consistent evidence across criteria, not selection of the most favorable result.

knowledge.title: 重工可行性
knowledge.text: 重工決策仍受材料餘量與缺陷機制限制。
knowledge.textEn: Rework remains constrained by material allowance and the defect mechanism.

quiz.question: 一項必要量測尚未取得時，正確狀態是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What status is appropriate when a required measurement is missing?
options: 直接合格，因為沒有超限數字。
用另一批的平均值補入，再視為本批已量測。
待驗證，先補齊證據再決定放行。
optionsEn: Pass, because no out-of-limit number is present.
Fill in another lot’s average and treat this lot as measured.
Unverified; obtain the evidence before release.
quiz.explanation: 待驗證，先補齊證據再決定放行。 產品放行需要相互一致的多項證據，而非挑選最漂亮的一項。
quiz.explanationEn: Unverified; obtain the evidence before release. Release needs consistent evidence across criteria, not selection of the most favorable result.

courses.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied.

courses.title: 晶圓對晶圓混合接合
courses.summary: 以介電層與銅接墊的共同界面，理解平坦化、清潔、對位、接合及電性可靠度之間的依賴。
courses.summaryEn: Follow a shared dielectric-and-copper interface through planarization, cleaning, alignment, bonding and electrical reliability.

stages.title: 界面與版圖
stages.description: 先界定成對晶圓、接點與驗證結構。
stages.descriptionEn: Define the paired wafers, contacts and verification structures.

steps.title: 界定混合接合的兩種功能
steps.titleEn: Define the two functions of hybrid bonding
steps.objective: 區別介電層支撐與金屬導通。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish dielectric attachment from metal conduction.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩片面對面的截面，將介電層接觸與銅接墊接觸分色。追蹤一條訊號跨越界面的路徑，指出哪些位置負責支撐、哪些位置必須導通。
steps.instructionEn: Draw face-to-face sections and color dielectric and copper contacts separately. Trace one signal across the interface, identifying mechanical attachment and required electrical continuity.
steps.observation: 整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。
steps.observationEn: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.
steps.failure: 若把介電層畫成導線，重新檢查電流路徑與材料標記。
steps.failureEn: If dielectric is drawn as a wire, revisit the current path and material labels.
steps.check: 分別指定機械接合與電性接點的驗證方法。
steps.checkEn: Assign separate verification approaches to attachment and electrical contacts.

knowledge.title: 雙重界面
knowledge.text: 混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。
knowledge.textEn: Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface.

knowledge.title: 功能分驗
knowledge.text: 機械完整與電性導通互相關聯，但不能互相替代驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical integrity and electrical continuity are related but need separate evidence.

quiz.question: 看見整片沒有分離，能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does observing that the wafers remain attached establish?
options: 提供機械貼合的部分證據，仍須電性驗證。
介電貼合強度已足以代表所有接觸電阻。
只要外圓重合，就證明每一接墊的隔離合格。
optionsEn: It provides some attachment evidence; electrical verification remains necessary.
Dielectric attachment strength fully represents every contact resistance.
Overlapping outlines prove isolation of every pad.
quiz.explanation: 提供機械貼合的部分證據，仍須電性驗證。 混合接合把介電層連接與嵌入金屬互連結合在同一界面。
quiz.explanationEn: It provides some attachment evidence; electrical verification remains necessary. Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface.

steps.title: 核對成對晶圓的版圖與方位
steps.titleEn: Check paired layouts and orientation
steps.objective: 避免面對面翻轉造成接點配對錯誤。
steps.objectiveEn: Prevent contact mismatches caused by face-to-face reversal.
steps.instruction: 在透明紙或繪圖軟體畫兩片含不對稱記號的晶圓。將上片翻面，逐一對應接墊與方向標記，再比較旋轉與鏡射的差異。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two wafers with asymmetric marks on transparent sheets or in drawing software. Flip the upper wafer and match pads and orientation marks, comparing rotation with reflection.
steps.observation: 對稱圖案可能掩蓋翻面錯誤，因此保留不對稱檢查點。
steps.observationEn: Symmetric patterns can hide a reversal error, so retain an asymmetric check.
steps.failure: 只對齊外圓卻錯配接墊時，應回到座標轉換，而非微調所有接點。
steps.failureEn: If wafer outlines align but pads mismatch, revisit coordinate transforms rather than adjust every contact.
steps.check: 用三個非共線標記驗證方向，並說明翻面後的接點對應。
steps.checkEn: Verify orientation with three non-collinear marks and explain pad correspondence after flipping.

knowledge.title: 座標轉換
knowledge.text: 面對面接合需要一致的翻面、旋轉與位移定義。
knowledge.textEn: Face-to-face bonding needs consistent definitions of reflection, rotation and translation.

knowledge.title: 不對稱標記
knowledge.text: 不對稱資訊能區分看似相同的錯誤方位。
knowledge.textEn: Asymmetric information distinguishes otherwise similar incorrect orientations.

quiz.question: 外圓重合但不對稱標記相反，優先檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Outlines overlap but asymmetric marks reverse. What should be checked first?
options: 只調整同一平移量，不檢查是否鏡射。
翻面與座標對應規則。
只看晶圓外圓，因為圖案方位不影響接點對應。
optionsEn: Apply one translation without checking for reflection.
The flip and coordinate-mapping rules.
Inspect the wafer outline only, assuming pattern orientation cannot affect matching.
quiz.explanation: 翻面與座標對應規則。 面對面接合需要一致的翻面、旋轉與位移定義。
quiz.explanationEn: The flip and coordinate-mapping rules. Face-to-face bonding needs consistent definitions of reflection, rotation and translation.

steps.title: 比較接墊尺寸與容許偏移
steps.titleEn: Compare pad size and overlay allowance
steps.objective: 理解接觸重疊與相鄰間距的共同限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand joint limits from contact overlap and neighbor spacing.
steps.instruction: 畫一組等尺寸接墊與一組上下不同尺寸接墊，逐次平移上層透明圖。記錄何時重疊不足或接近鄰點；所有尺寸自行假設，不能套用為製造規格。
steps.instructionEn: Draw equal-size and unequal-size pad pairs and translate the upper overlay. Record loss of overlap or approach to a neighbor; label all dimensions hypothetical, not manufacturing specifications.
steps.observation: 增加接墊大小可改善部分重疊，但也會改變相鄰間距。
steps.observationEn: Enlarging a pad can improve overlap while changing neighbor clearance.
steps.failure: 只最大化重疊而忽略鄰近接點，可能隱藏短路或介電風險。
steps.failureEn: Maximizing overlap while ignoring neighbors can conceal shorting or dielectric risk.
steps.check: 同時呈現重疊與間距兩項判據，並指出適用的偏移方向。
steps.checkEn: Show both overlap and clearance criteria and identify the displacement directions considered.

knowledge.title: 版圖容差
knowledge.text: 接墊形狀與相對尺寸會改變對位誤差的容忍度。
knowledge.textEn: Pad geometry and relative size affect tolerance to alignment error.

knowledge.title: 局部代價
knowledge.text: 幾何上的改良須連同鄰點間距和電性一起評估。
knowledge.textEn: A geometric improvement must be assessed with neighbor spacing and electrical behavior.

quiz.question: 為何不能無限制放大所有接墊？
quiz.questionEn: Why not enlarge every pad without limit?
options: 接墊加大只會改善重疊，不影響鄰近間距。
只要銅面積增加，就不需考慮介電隔離。
重疊改善可能消耗鄰點間距。
optionsEn: Enlarging pads improves overlap without affecting neighbor spacing.
More copper area removes the need to consider dielectric isolation.
Improved overlap can consume neighbor clearance.
quiz.explanation: 重疊改善可能消耗鄰點間距。 接墊形狀與相對尺寸會改變對位誤差的容忍度。
quiz.explanationEn: Improved overlap can consume neighbor clearance. Pad geometry and relative size affect tolerance to alignment error.

steps.title: 配置串鏈與隔離測試結構
steps.titleEn: Plan chain and isolation test structures
steps.objective: 讓開路與相鄰漏電能被分開發現。
steps.objectiveEn: Make opens and neighbor leakage separately observable.
steps.instruction: 在示意版圖串接多個跨界面接點，另畫相鄰但不相連的導體。預測單一開路、接觸電阻增加及鄰點短路，各會改變哪項測試結果。
steps.instructionEn: Chain multiple cross-interface contacts in a schematic and draw separate adjacent conductors. Predict which measurements change for an open, higher contact resistance or a neighbor short.
steps.observation: 串鏈只顯示累積路徑，未必能定位單一異常接點。
steps.observationEn: A chain exposes a cumulative path but may not localize one defective contact.
steps.failure: 把低串鏈電阻當作隔離合格會漏掉另一種故障；保留獨立隔離判據。
steps.failureEn: Treating low chain resistance as proof of isolation misses another failure class; retain a separate criterion.
steps.check: 建立故障、測試結構與可見現象的三欄對照。
steps.checkEn: Map each fault to a test structure and observable response.

knowledge.title: 可觀測性
knowledge.text: 測試結構必須讓想找的失效改變可讀取的量。
knowledge.textEn: A test structure must make the targeted failure affect an observable quantity.

knowledge.title: 累積與定位
knowledge.text: 整條串鏈的結果與單一接點的結果具有不同解析度。
knowledge.textEn: Whole-chain and individual-contact results have different diagnostic resolution.

quiz.question: 串鏈可導通，還需要哪類補充證據？
quiz.questionEn: A chain conducts. What complementary evidence is still useful?
options: 相鄰導體的隔離與漏電檢查。
只重複同一串鏈讀值，不需要不同測試結構。
只檢查機械接合強度便能排除相鄰短路。
optionsEn: Isolation and leakage checks between neighboring conductors.
Repeat the same chain reading; different test structures are unnecessary.
Mechanical bond strength alone rules out neighbor shorts.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰導體的隔離與漏電檢查。 測試結構必須讓想找的失效改變可讀取的量。
quiz.explanationEn: Isolation and leakage checks between neighboring conductors. A test structure must make the targeted failure affect an observable quantity.

stages.title: 表面與對位
stages.description: 區分表面幾何、表面狀態與面內對位的限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate limits from surface geometry, surface condition and in-plane alignment.

steps.title: 判讀 CMP 後的銅凹陷與介電平坦度
steps.titleEn: Interpret copper recess and dielectric flatness
steps.objective: 分開比較銅高度與介電面形貌。
steps.objectiveEn: Compare copper height separately from dielectric topography.
steps.instruction: 畫出銅突出、合適凹陷及過深凹陷三種假想截面，標出首先接觸的位置。比較它們對介電貼合與後續金屬連接的影響，不設定通用奈米公差。
steps.instructionEn: Draw hypothetical protruding, appropriately recessed and deeply recessed copper sections. Mark first-contact locations and compare dielectric attachment and later metal connection without assigning universal nanometer tolerances.
steps.observation: 全片平均平坦仍可能掩蓋某些接墊的局部高度問題。
steps.observationEn: Good average flatness can still hide local pad-height problems.
steps.failure: 把所有材料畫成完全齊平，可能遺失研究流程所需的受控凹陷；回查來源路線。
steps.failureEn: Drawing every material perfectly flush can erase the controlled recess required by the referenced route; review its assumptions.
steps.check: 說明三種截面的不同風險，且將量產公差保留為待查規格。
steps.checkEn: Explain the distinct risks and leave production tolerances as requirements to obtain.

knowledge.title: 受控形貌
knowledge.text: 接合前形貌須同時配合介電接觸及後續銅連接。
knowledge.textEn: Prebond topography must accommodate both dielectric contact and subsequent copper connection.

knowledge.title: 局部高度
knowledge.text: 銅凹陷相對於鄰近介電面定義，不能只看晶圓平均厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Copper recess is relative to nearby dielectric, not merely average wafer thickness.

quiz.question: 銅凹陷應相對於哪個基準判讀？
quiz.questionEn: What reference defines copper recess?
options: 整片晶圓背面的平均平面。
相鄰介電表面。
尚未拋光前的總銅沉積厚度。
optionsEn: The average plane of the wafer backside.
The adjacent dielectric surface.
Total copper thickness before polishing.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰介電表面。 接合前形貌須同時配合介電接觸及後續銅連接。
quiz.explanationEn: The adjacent dielectric surface. Prebond topography must accommodate both dielectric contact and subsequent copper connection.

steps.title: 追溯清潔、活化與等待時間
steps.titleEn: Trace cleaning, activation and waiting
steps.objective: 將表面狀態與後續接合條件連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect surface condition to subsequent bonding conditions.
steps.instruction: 建立清潔、表面活化、等待與接合的時間線，為兩條假設路徑標記暴露及搬運點。比較粒子控制與活化目的，不推定兩者可互相取代。
steps.instructionEn: Build timelines for cleaning, activation, waiting and bonding, marking exposure and handling in two hypothetical routes. Compare particle control with activation without treating them as interchangeable.
steps.observation: 兩片幾何相同的表面，仍可能因狀態或污染不同而表現不同。
steps.observationEn: Geometrically similar surfaces can behave differently because of condition or contamination.
steps.failure: 缺少交接時間紀錄時，不能把不良全歸因於對位。
steps.failureEn: Without handoff timing records, do not attribute all failures to overlay.
steps.check: 時間線包含每次表面暴露與可追溯的狀態紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Include each exposure and a traceable surface-condition record.

knowledge.title: 表面功能
knowledge.text: 介電層直接接合依賴適當的表面狀態，不只是兩片相碰。
knowledge.textEn: Direct dielectric bonding depends on suitable surface condition, not merely physical contact.

knowledge.title: 交接窗口
knowledge.text: 等待和搬運也是流程條件，應與清潔及活化一起記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Waiting and handling are process conditions that belong with cleaning and activation records.

quiz.question: 活化後延長等待，為何仍需重新核對接合條件？
quiz.questionEn: Why review bonding conditions after a longer post-activation wait?
options: 只要對位精度相同，表面暴露時間就不影響判定。
等待越久必然接合越強，不需檢查表面狀態。
表面狀態和暴露歷程可能改變。
optionsEn: Equal overlay accuracy makes surface-exposure time irrelevant.
A longer wait always strengthens bonding without checking surface condition.
Surface condition and exposure history may change.
quiz.explanation: 表面狀態和暴露歷程可能改變。 介電層直接接合依賴適當的表面狀態，不只是兩片相碰。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface condition and exposure history may change. Direct dielectric bonding depends on suitable surface condition, not merely physical contact.

steps.title: 分離平移、旋轉與變形誤差
steps.titleEn: Separate translation, rotation and distortion
steps.objective: 用多位置標記判斷對位誤差模式。
steps.objectiveEn: Diagnose overlay-error patterns from multiple marks.
steps.instruction: 在中心與四個外圍位置畫誤差箭頭，分別建立同向、繞中心旋轉及局部不規則三個案例。嘗試以一個平移修正各案例，觀察哪些殘差無法消除。
steps.instructionEn: Draw overlay vectors at the center and four outer positions for translation, rotation and irregular local distortion. Apply one translation correction to each and identify residuals it cannot remove.
steps.observation: 中心對好仍可能在邊緣有旋轉或形變殘差。
steps.observationEn: Good center alignment can coexist with rotational or distortion residuals at the edge.
steps.failure: 只用單一標記決定全片合格會忽略誤差模式；增加空間取樣。
steps.failureEn: One-mark acceptance overlooks error structure; add spatial sampling.
steps.check: 將每種誤差對應到可修正部分與待調查部分。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish correctable components from residuals requiring investigation.

knowledge.title: 誤差場
knowledge.text: 對位是一個空間分布，不只是單一偏移值。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay is a spatial field, not just one offset.

knowledge.title: 剛體限制
knowledge.text: 平移與旋轉不能完全補償所有局部變形。
knowledge.textEn: Translation and rotation cannot fully compensate every local distortion.

quiz.question: 平移後中心已對齊但邊緣仍繞中心偏轉，較像哪種誤差？
quiz.questionEn: Translation fixes the center but edge vectors remain rotational. What does this suggest?
options: 仍有旋轉分量。
單純固定方向的平移，中心結果足以代表全片。
一定是所有接墊同等加寬，無需檢查對位模型。
optionsEn: A remaining rotational component.
Pure fixed-direction translation, with center results representing the entire wafer.
Every pad must have widened equally, requiring no alignment-model review.
quiz.explanation: 仍有旋轉分量。 對位是一個空間分布，不只是單一偏移值。
quiz.explanationEn: A remaining rotational component. Overlay is a spatial field, not just one offset.

steps.title: 規劃接合前的雙面放行
steps.titleEn: Plan a two-surface prebond review
steps.objective: 防止只檢查其中一片晶圓。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid checking only one member of the wafer pair.
steps.instruction: 為上下晶圓各建一張表，列出身分、方位、形貌、污染與等待歷程。挑選一項缺失資料，討論它如何影響整對晶圓的放行，而非以另一片的結果補值。
steps.instructionEn: Make separate records for wafer identity, orientation, topography, contamination and waiting history. Remove one item and explain how that affects pair release rather than substituting the other wafer’s result.
steps.observation: 接合是成對事件，單片合格不等於配對與界面均合格。
steps.observationEn: Bonding is a paired event; one acceptable wafer does not prove a valid pair or interface.
steps.failure: 批次或方位配對錯誤不能靠後段退火修正。
steps.failureEn: Annealing cannot repair an incorrect lot or orientation pairing.
steps.check: 放行表可從接合批次追溯到兩片來料及各自量測。
steps.checkEn: Trace the bonded lot to both incoming wafers and their individual measurements.

knowledge.title: 配對追溯
knowledge.text: 兩側輸入共同決定接合界面品質。
knowledge.textEn: Both inputs jointly determine interface quality.

knowledge.title: 缺值處理
knowledge.text: 另一片的好結果不能補足本片缺少的證據。
knowledge.textEn: A good result from one wafer cannot fill an evidence gap for the other.

quiz.question: 上片形貌合格、下片未量測，正確結論為何？
quiz.questionEn: The upper wafer passes topography checks but the lower is unmeasured. What follows?
options: 下片可沿用上片結果，因為兩片目標規格相同。
整對晶圓仍待驗證。
對位設備型號相同，就不需要下片形貌證據。
optionsEn: The lower wafer can inherit the upper result because target specifications match.
The pair remains unverified.
The same aligner model removes the need for lower-wafer topography evidence.
quiz.explanation: 整對晶圓仍待驗證。 兩側輸入共同決定接合界面品質。
quiz.explanationEn: The pair remains unverified. Both inputs jointly determine interface quality.

stages.title: 接合與驗證
stages.description: 結合機械、空洞與電性證據，避免只用外觀判定接合成功。
stages.descriptionEn: Combine mechanical, void and electrical evidence rather than judge a bond by appearance.

steps.title: 觀察接合波與未接合區域
steps.titleEn: Observe the bond wave and unbonded regions
steps.objective: 把接觸傳播與空洞證據連結。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate contact propagation to void evidence.
steps.instruction: 在原創示意圖畫出由起始接觸點擴展的接合前緣，再加入一個粒子與一個局部形貌障礙。預測可能留下的未接合區，與來源影像中的觀察方法比較。
steps.instructionEn: Draw an original bond front spreading from initial contact, then add one particle and one local topographic obstacle. Predict unbonded regions and compare the observation approach with referenced imagery.
steps.observation: 前緣通過與界面完全無空洞是不同判斷。
steps.observationEn: Passage of a bond front is not the same conclusion as a void-free interface.
steps.failure: 若只保存最終外觀，可能缺少判斷缺陷起源的時間資訊。
steps.failureEn: Keeping only the final appearance may lose timing needed to diagnose defect origins.
steps.check: 標記預測區域、可檢查的方法及不能由示意圖證明的部分。
steps.checkEn: Mark predicted regions, an inspection approach and what the schematic cannot prove.

knowledge.title: 接觸傳播
knowledge.text: 表面接觸可沿界面擴展，局部障礙會影響完整貼合。
knowledge.textEn: Contact can propagate along the interface, while local obstacles affect complete attachment.

knowledge.title: 空洞定位
knowledge.text: 缺陷位置需與前處理和形貌紀錄交叉比較。
knowledge.textEn: Defect locations should be compared with preparation and topography records.

quiz.question: 模型顯示接合前緣已到邊緣，仍需檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: The modeled bond front reaches the edge. What still needs checking?
options: 只需確認接觸前緣速度，無需檢查內部區域。
只量測外圓厚度，就可取代界面檢查。
界面內是否殘留未接合區。
optionsEn: Only bond-front speed needs checking, not interior regions.
Edge thickness alone replaces interface inspection.
Whether unbonded regions remain inside the interface.
quiz.explanation: 界面內是否殘留未接合區。 表面接觸可沿界面擴展，局部障礙會影響完整貼合。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether unbonded regions remain inside the interface. Contact can propagate along the interface, while local obstacles affect complete attachment.

steps.title: 判讀退火對介電層與銅連接的作用
steps.titleEn: Interpret annealing of dielectric and copper bonds
steps.objective: 區分初始貼合與後續接合強化。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish initial attachment from subsequent bond strengthening.
steps.instruction: 用前後兩張截面圖標出預接合與退火後狀態，分別追蹤介電界面及銅接點。列出需向實際製程取得的熱預算與材料相容性資料，不填入通用溫度配方。
steps.instructionEn: Compare prebond and post-anneal sections, following dielectric interfaces and copper contacts separately. List thermal-budget and compatibility information needed from the actual process without inventing a universal temperature recipe.
steps.observation: 某條研究路線的可用條件不代表所有介電材料與金屬堆疊皆適用。
steps.observationEn: Conditions demonstrated for one research route do not apply automatically to every dielectric and metal stack.
steps.failure: 用提高溫度補償未知污染，可能增加其他損害而未處理根因。
steps.failureEn: Raising temperature to compensate for unknown contamination may add damage without addressing the cause.
steps.check: 說明退火前後需要不同證據，並保留產品熱限制。
steps.checkEn: Explain the evidence needed before and after annealing and retain product thermal constraints.

knowledge.title: 接合演變
knowledge.text: 初始貼合與永久介電、金屬接合的形成是不同階段。
knowledge.textEn: Initial attachment and development of permanent dielectric and metal bonds are distinct stages.

knowledge.title: 熱預算相容性
knowledge.text: 接合條件須與先前完成的元件和互連相容。
knowledge.textEn: Bonding conditions must remain compatible with existing devices and interconnects.

quiz.question: 能否把研究文章中的退火條件直接當所有產品配方？
quiz.questionEn: Can an article’s anneal condition become the recipe for every product?
options: 不能，材料、堆疊與熱預算需分別核對。
能，只要研究和產品使用相同晶圓直徑。
能，所有既有互連對接合熱歷程的承受能力相同。
optionsEn: No; materials, stacks and thermal budgets need separate review.
Yes, if research and product wafer diameters match.
Yes; all existing interconnects tolerate the same bonding thermal history.
quiz.explanation: 不能，材料、堆疊與熱預算需分別核對。 初始貼合與永久介電、金屬接合的形成是不同階段。
quiz.explanationEn: No; materials, stacks and thermal budgets need separate review. Initial attachment and development of permanent dielectric and metal bonds are distinct stages.

steps.title: 交叉判讀空洞、串鏈與接點電阻
steps.titleEn: Cross-check voids, chains and contact resistance
steps.objective: 避免單一測試掩蓋不同失效模式。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid allowing one test to conceal other failure modes.
steps.instruction: 製作四個紙上案例：外觀正常但串鏈開路、可導通但局部空洞、阻值偏高及各項一致。為每例選擇下一個能縮小原因範圍的量測，而非立即重工。
steps.instructionEn: Create paper cases with a normal appearance but open chain, conduction with local voids, elevated resistance and consistent results. Choose the next discriminating measurement before proposing rework.
steps.observation: 不同證據可能互補，也可能揭露取樣範圍不一致。
steps.observationEn: Different evidence can complement itself or reveal inconsistent sampling coverage.
steps.failure: 若把測到一條好串鏈擴大成整片合格，需回查測試覆蓋率。
steps.failureEn: If one good chain becomes a claim about the entire wafer, revisit coverage.
steps.check: 每個異常結論均指出測試覆蓋範圍及尚未排除的原因。
steps.checkEn: State test coverage and remaining possible causes for every abnormal conclusion.

knowledge.title: 多物理驗證
knowledge.text: 機械界面與電性路徑需要交叉驗證，才能縮小失效原因。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical interface and electrical-path evidence must be combined to narrow causes.

knowledge.title: 取樣覆蓋
knowledge.text: 局部良好結果不等於未量測區域已被證明良好。
knowledge.textEn: A good local result does not establish the condition of unmeasured regions.

quiz.question: 一條串鏈正常但附近影像有空洞，最佳解讀是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: One chain passes but nearby imaging shows a void. What is the best interpretation?
options: 串鏈導通已足以排除所有機械界面缺陷。
兩種測試覆蓋與失效敏感性不同，需交叉定位。
有局部空洞便可認定整片每個接點都開路。
optionsEn: Chain continuity rules out every mechanical-interface defect.
Coverage and failure sensitivity differ; correlate their locations.
One local void proves every wafer contact is open.
quiz.explanation: 兩種測試覆蓋與失效敏感性不同，需交叉定位。 機械界面與電性路徑需要交叉驗證，才能縮小失效原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coverage and failure sensitivity differ; correlate their locations. Mechanical interface and electrical-path evidence must be combined to narrow causes.

steps.title: 建立接合批次的可靠度與交接表
steps.titleEn: Build a bond-lot reliability handoff
steps.objective: 將製程條件、初始結果與後續變化連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Link process conditions, initial results and later changes.
steps.instruction: 把配對識別、對位地圖、形貌、接合紀錄及初始電性放入一張交接表。再加入假設的應力前後結果，區分初始缺陷和隨時間出現的劣化。
steps.instructionEn: Combine pairing, overlay, topography, bond history and initial electrical results in a handoff sheet. Add hypothetical before-and-after stress results to distinguish initial defects from later degradation.
steps.observation: 初始可導通不代表經應力後仍維持相同表現。
steps.observationEn: Initial continuity does not guarantee unchanged behavior after stress.
steps.failure: 沒有初始基線便難以判斷變化；先補足基線與樣本對應。
steps.failureEn: Without a baseline, change is hard to judge; restore baseline and sample correspondence.
steps.check: 為放行、複查與後續可靠度驗證各列出條件，不宣稱教學模型已證明量產可靠度。
steps.checkEn: Define release, review and later reliability conditions without claiming that the teaching model proves production reliability.

knowledge.title: 基線比較
knowledge.text: 可靠度觀察需要把同一樣本的初始與後續證據連接。
knowledge.textEn: Reliability observations need a link between the same sample’s initial and later evidence.

knowledge.title: 工程交接
knowledge.text: 後段薄化、互連與測試需知道接合界面的限制與未解問題。
knowledge.textEn: Later thinning, interconnect and test operations need interface limits and unresolved issues.

quiz.question: 為何保留應力測試前的電性基線？
quiz.questionEn: Why retain electrical results from before a stress test?
options: 用基線直接代替所有應力後量測。
只比較不同批次的最終平均值，不追蹤同一樣本。
用來識別後續變化，而不只看最終數字。
optionsEn: Substitute the baseline for every post-stress measurement.
Compare only final averages from different lots without tracking the same sample.
To identify change rather than view only a final number.
quiz.explanation: 用來識別後續變化，而不只看最終數字。 可靠度觀察需要把同一樣本的初始與後續證據連接。
quiz.explanationEn: To identify change rather than view only a final number. Reliability observations need a link between the same sample’s initial and later evidence.

courses.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied.

courses.title: 消色差透鏡設計
courses.summary: 用玻璃色散、光焦度分配與成像驗證，理解雙合透鏡如何降低色差，以及仍須處理的像差與公差。
courses.summaryEn: Use glass dispersion, optical-power allocation and imaging checks to understand chromatic correction and its remaining aberrations and tolerances.

stages.title: 需求與材料
stages.description: 先固定波段及共軛，再建立薄透鏡的初步設計。
stages.descriptionEn: Fix spectrum and conjugates before building a preliminary thin-lens design.

steps.title: 界定波段、共軛與成像需求
steps.titleEn: Define spectrum, conjugates and imaging needs
steps.objective: 定義消色差設計要同時服務的波長與物像條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Define the wavelengths and object-image conditions the achromat must serve.
steps.instruction: 畫出紅、綠、藍三條代表光路和一個共同像面，再分別標記遠方物體與近距物體。為比較選定相同的光圈與成像尺度，避免一邊改波長一邊改物距。
steps.instructionEn: Draw representative red, green and blue paths and one image plane, then label distant and near objects. Hold aperture and image scale consistent so spectrum and object distance are not changed together.
steps.observation: 單色清楚與多色共同成像是不同要求；物距改變也會改變成像條件。
steps.observationEn: Single-color sharpness and common multicolor imaging are different requirements; object distance also changes the conjugates.
steps.failure: 若只寫「影像清晰」，便無法區分波段、視場或解析度要求。
steps.failureEn: A requirement of merely clear imaging cannot distinguish spectrum, field or resolution.
steps.check: 需求表包含波段、物像條件、光圈及需要比較的像面。
steps.checkEn: Record spectrum, conjugates, aperture and the image plane used for comparison.

knowledge.title: 共軛條件
knowledge.text: 同一透鏡在不同物距下，不一定具有相同像差表現。
knowledge.textEn: One lens does not necessarily have the same aberration behavior at different object distances.

knowledge.title: 共同像面
knowledge.text: 消色差評估要比較多個波長，不可只挑最好的一色。
knowledge.textEn: Chromatic evaluation compares multiple wavelengths rather than selecting the best-performing color.

quiz.question: 只展示綠光的清晰影像，能否證明消色差符合需求？
quiz.questionEn: Does one sharp green image prove chromatic requirements are met?
options: 不能，還需在相同條件下比較其他指定波長。
能，只要綠光的焦點正好在感測器平面。
能，只要使用相同玻璃材料，波長不需另測。
optionsEn: No; compare the other specified wavelengths under the same conditions.
Yes, if green focus lies exactly at the sensor plane.
Yes; the same glass removes the need for separate wavelengths.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需在相同條件下比較其他指定波長。 同一透鏡在不同物距下，不一定具有相同像差表現。
quiz.explanationEn: No; compare the other specified wavelengths under the same conditions. One lens does not necessarily have the same aberration behavior at different object distances.

steps.title: 閱讀折射率與阿貝數資料
steps.titleEn: Read refractive-index and Abbe-number data
steps.objective: 區分折射能力與色散的材料指標。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish material measures of refraction and dispersion.
steps.instruction: 從 SCHOTT 資料選兩種玻璃，記下折射率、阿貝數及其光譜線定義。以同一參考線比較，圈出高折射率但不必然低色散的情況。
steps.instructionEn: Choose two glasses from SCHOTT data and record refractive index, Abbe number and spectral-line definitions. Compare using the same reference line and identify why high index does not necessarily mean low dispersion.
steps.observation: 注意 nd、ne 或不同阿貝數定義不可不經轉換便混用。
steps.observationEn: Do not mix nd, ne or differently defined Abbe numbers without accounting for their definitions.
steps.failure: 只挑折射率最大的材料，可能使色差配置更困難。
steps.failureEn: Choosing the highest-index material alone may make chromatic balancing harder.
steps.check: 材料表保留資料來源、參考波長和色散定義。
steps.checkEn: Retain data source, reference wavelength and dispersion definition in the material table.

knowledge.title: 色散指標
knowledge.text: 阿貝數描述指定光譜線間的相對色散，不能等同折射率。
knowledge.textEn: Abbe number describes relative dispersion across specified spectral lines, not refractive index itself.

knowledge.title: 定義一致
knowledge.text: 比較材料前先對齊參考光譜線與溫度等條件。
knowledge.textEn: Align reference spectral lines and conditions such as temperature before comparing materials.

quiz.question: 兩張表分別使用 nd/Vd 與 ne/Ve，最佳做法是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Two tables use nd/Vd and ne/Ve respectively. What is the best approach?
options: 只比較數字大小，忽略其參考光譜線。
先核對光譜線定義，再作一致條件比較。
只要兩者皆稱阿貝數，就可以直接互換定義。
optionsEn: Compare numerical values while ignoring their reference spectral lines.
Check spectral-line definitions before making a consistent comparison.
Since both are called Abbe numbers, their definitions are interchangeable.
quiz.explanation: 先核對光譜線定義，再作一致條件比較。 阿貝數描述指定光譜線間的相對色散，不能等同折射率。
quiz.explanationEn: Check spectral-line definitions before making a consistent comparison. Abbe number describes relative dispersion across specified spectral lines, not refractive index itself.

steps.title: 分配正負光焦度
steps.titleEn: Allocate positive and negative optical power
steps.objective: 以薄透鏡近似建立一階消色差條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish first-order achromatization using a thin-lens approximation.
steps.instruction: 以明確假設的 V1=60、V2=30、總光焦度 10 m⁻¹ 試算。聯立 Φ1+Φ2=10 與 Φ1/V1+Φ2/V2=0，求兩片光焦度，再換算焦距並標註接觸薄透鏡假設。
steps.instructionEn: Use hypothetical V1=60, V2=30 and total power 10 m⁻¹. Solve Φ1+Φ2=10 and Φ1/V1+Φ2/V2=0, convert the powers to focal lengths and label the contacting-thin-lens assumption.
steps.observation: 所得正片光焦度大於總光焦度，負片抵銷部分光焦度與色散。
steps.observationEn: The positive element has more power than the total; the negative element cancels part of its power and dispersion.
steps.failure: 混用毫米與公尺會造成千倍焦距錯誤；每行試算保留單位。
steps.failureEn: Mixing millimeters and meters causes a factor-of-one-thousand focal-length error; keep units on every line.
steps.check: 得到 Φ1=20、Φ2=-10 m⁻¹，且能說明厚度與間隙尚未納入。
steps.checkEn: Obtain Φ1=20 and Φ2=-10 m⁻¹ and explain that thickness and spacing are not yet included.

knowledge.title: 光焦度平衡
knowledge.text: 接觸薄透鏡的總光焦度為各片光焦度之和；色散需另滿足平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Contacting thin-lens powers add, while dispersion needs a separate balance.

knowledge.title: 近似範圍
knowledge.text: 一階試算是起點，不能取代實際厚透鏡追跡。
knowledge.textEn: First-order calculation is a starting point, not a replacement for thick-lens ray tracing.

quiz.question: 本例兩片光焦度應為哪組？
quiz.questionEn: Which pair of powers satisfies the example?
options: 5 與 5 m⁻¹。
optionsEn: 5 and 5 m⁻¹.
10 and 10 m⁻¹.
20 and -10 m⁻¹.
quiz.explanation: 20 與 -10 m⁻¹。 接觸薄透鏡的總光焦度為各片光焦度之和；色散需另滿足平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: 20 and -10 m⁻¹. Contacting thin-lens powers add, while dispersion needs a separate balance.

steps.title: 檢查兩色重合與次級光譜
steps.titleEn: Check two-color correction and residual spectrum
steps.objective: 理解雙合透鏡仍可能保留中間波長的焦移。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why an achromat can retain intermediate-wavelength focus shifts.
steps.instruction: 畫出焦點位置隨波長的示意曲線，將兩個設計波長調至同一焦點，再保留中間波長的偏差。比較「兩點重合」與「整條曲線為零」的差異。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a schematic focus-versus-wavelength curve, bring two design wavelengths to a common focus and retain an intermediate offset. Compare two-point coincidence with a curve that is zero everywhere.
steps.observation: 兩色對齊不代表所有可見光或紅外線都同樣對齊。
steps.observationEn: Correcting two colors does not align every visible or infrared wavelength equally.
steps.failure: 將名稱中的「消色差」解讀成零色差，會提出不合理驗收。
steps.failureEn: Reading achromatic as zero chromatic error creates unrealistic acceptance criteria.
steps.check: 明確標記設計波段和剩餘焦移，而非只畫兩條重合光線。
steps.checkEn: Mark the design band and remaining focus shift, not only two coincident rays.

knowledge.title: 次級光譜
knowledge.text: 兩波長的一階修正通常仍留下其他波長的殘差。
knowledge.textEn: First-order correction at two wavelengths generally leaves residuals at others.

knowledge.title: 波段限制
knowledge.text: 材料與設計波段共同限定可宣稱的表現。
knowledge.textEn: Materials and the design band limit the performance claim.

quiz.question: 兩個設計波長焦點重合，哪個結論仍不成立？
quiz.questionEn: Two design wavelengths share a focus. Which conclusion is still unsupported?
options: 所有波長都完全沒有色差。
指定兩波長的一階焦移已降低。
仍須查看其他指定波長。
optionsEn: Every wavelength is completely free of chromatic error.
First-order focus separation for the specified pair is reduced.
Other specified wavelengths still need checking.
quiz.explanation: 「所有波長都完全沒有色差」超出兩色焦點重合所能證明的範圍；中間或其他波長仍可能留下次級光譜。
quiz.explanationEn: The claim that every wavelength is free of chromatic error exceeds what two coincident focal positions prove; intermediate and other wavelengths can retain secondary spectrum.

stages.title: 形狀與組裝
stages.description: 比較表面彎曲、光圈、方向與偏心對成像的影響。
stages.descriptionEn: Compare curvature, aperture, orientation and decentration effects.

steps.title: 比較曲率配置與透鏡形狀
steps.titleEn: Compare curvature allocation and lens shape
steps.objective: 分辨相同光焦度下不同形狀的像差。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish aberrations of different shapes with similar power.
steps.instruction: 保持材料與近似總光焦度不變，畫出較對稱與較彎曲的兩組表面。標示中心與邊緣光線，討論為何一階焦距相近仍需進一步追跡。
steps.instructionEn: Hold materials and approximate total power fixed and draw more symmetric and more strongly bent surface pairs. Mark central and marginal rays and explain why similar paraxial focal length still requires ray tracing.
steps.observation: 表面彎曲的分配會影響邊緣光線，而不只改變透鏡外觀。
steps.observationEn: Allocation of surface curvature affects marginal rays, not just appearance.
steps.failure: 只保留焦距欄位會漏掉形狀資訊；補上曲率符號和光行方向。
steps.failureEn: A focal-length-only record omits shape; add curvature signs and propagation direction.
steps.check: 兩個候選均保留表面順序、曲率符號與比較條件。
steps.checkEn: Retain surface order, curvature signs and comparison conditions for both candidates.

knowledge.title: 彎曲自由度
knowledge.text: 相近一階光焦度可由不同曲率分配實現。
knowledge.textEn: Similar paraxial power can arise from different curvature distributions.

knowledge.title: 邊緣光線
knowledge.text: 有限光圈下的光線不一定遵循近軸近似。
knowledge.textEn: Rays at finite aperture need not follow the paraxial approximation.

quiz.question: 兩個設計焦距相同，能否因此判定成像品質相同？
quiz.questionEn: Do equal focal lengths prove equal image quality?
options: 能，一階焦距已完整決定有限光圈像差。
不能，表面形狀和有限光圈像差仍可能不同。
能，只要兩者玻璃相同，曲率分配就沒有作用。
optionsEn: Yes; paraxial focal length fully determines finite-aperture aberrations.
No; surface shape and finite-aperture aberrations may differ.
Yes; with identical glass, curvature allocation has no effect.
quiz.explanation: 不能，表面形狀和有限光圈像差仍可能不同。 相近一階光焦度可由不同曲率分配實現。
quiz.explanationEn: No; surface shape and finite-aperture aberrations may differ. Similar paraxial power can arise from different curvature distributions.

steps.title: 區分球差、彗差與色差
steps.titleEn: Separate spherical aberration, coma and color
steps.objective: 避免用改變波長解釋所有模糊。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid attributing every blur to wavelength changes.
steps.instruction: 分別畫單一波長的軸上邊緣光線、離軸光束和多波長軸上光束。為每張圖只改變一種因素：光圈、視場或波長，對應可能的像差類型。
steps.instructionEn: Draw on-axis marginal rays at one wavelength, an off-axis bundle and a multicolor on-axis bundle. Change only aperture, field or wavelength in each to associate the relevant aberration.
steps.observation: 單色仍有模糊時，不能全歸因於玻璃色散。
steps.observationEn: Blur that remains in monochromatic light cannot all be attributed to dispersion.
steps.failure: 多因素同時改變會讓診斷失去可比性；返回一因素比較。
steps.failureEn: Changing multiple factors at once destroys diagnostic comparability; return to one-factor comparisons.
steps.check: 能為三種模糊各指定不同的控制變因與觀察。
steps.checkEn: Assign a distinct control variable and observation to each blur type.

knowledge.title: 像差分類
knowledge.text: 色差與單色像差有不同來源，修正一種不代表全部修正。
knowledge.textEn: Chromatic and monochromatic aberrations have different origins; correcting one does not correct all.

knowledge.title: 控制變因
knowledge.text: 波長固定後改變光圈，可把部分幾何像差與色差分開比較。
knowledge.textEn: Varying aperture at fixed wavelength helps separate geometric aberrations from color.

quiz.question: 固定單一波長後，縮小光圈使軸上模糊改善，優先懷疑什麼？
quiz.questionEn: At one wavelength, stopping down improves on-axis blur. What is a plausible concern?
options: 必定是不同波長之間的焦移，即使測試只有單一波長。
必定只有鍍膜透射率改變，光線幾何不需檢查。
與邊緣光線相關的單色像差。
optionsEn: It must be inter-wavelength focus shift even in a single-wavelength test.
It must be coating transmission alone, so ray geometry needs no review.
A monochromatic aberration involving marginal rays.
quiz.explanation: 與邊緣光線相關的單色像差。 色差與單色像差有不同來源，修正一種不代表全部修正。
quiz.explanationEn: A monochromatic aberration involving marginal rays. Chromatic and monochromatic aberrations have different origins; correcting one does not correct all.

steps.title: 確認雙合透鏡的安裝方向
steps.titleEn: Check doublet orientation
steps.objective: 將標示方向與設計共軛對應。
steps.objectiveEn: Match mounting orientation to the design conjugates.
steps.instruction: 為同一雙合透鏡畫正反兩種安裝圖，固定物距與像面。查閱所選元件的供應商方向說明，將實際朝向與設計條件對應，不假定每款雙合透鏡都可任意翻轉。
steps.instructionEn: Draw both mounting orientations for one doublet at fixed object distance and image plane. Consult the chosen component’s orientation guidance and match it to design conditions rather than assuming every doublet is reversible.
steps.observation: 焦距可能相近，但翻轉後的像差表現仍可改變。
steps.observationEn: Focal length may remain similar while aberration performance changes after reversal.
steps.failure: 只看外徑選方向會忽略光學表面配置；回查圖面和共軛。
steps.failureEn: Choosing orientation by diameter ignores surface arrangement; revisit the drawing and conjugates.
steps.check: 組裝圖有光行方向、元件朝向及依據來源。
steps.checkEn: Include propagation direction, component orientation and its supporting reference.

knowledge.title: 方向與共軛
knowledge.text: 透鏡方向應配合設計的物像條件。
knowledge.textEn: Lens orientation should match its intended object-image conditions.

knowledge.title: 標記追溯
knowledge.text: 機械可裝入不等於光學方向正確。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical fit does not establish correct optical orientation.

quiz.question: 透鏡正反都能裝入鏡筒，下一步應做什麼？
quiz.questionEn: The lens fits the barrel in either direction. What should happen next?
options: 核對元件圖面與設計共軛的方向。
只比較兩面直徑，直徑相同就可任選。
只測一次近軸焦距，就宣稱正反像差相同。
optionsEn: Check orientation against the component drawing and design conjugates.
Compare face diameters only; equal diameters allow either orientation.
Measure paraxial focal length once and declare equal aberrations both ways.
quiz.explanation: 核對元件圖面與設計共軛的方向。 透鏡方向應配合設計的物像條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Check orientation against the component drawing and design conjugates. Lens orientation should match its intended object-image conditions.

steps.title: 評估偏心、傾斜與膠合界面
steps.titleEn: Evaluate decentration, tilt and the cemented interface
steps.objective: 辨認組裝幾何與材料界面的不同風險。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish assembly geometry from interface-material risks.
steps.instruction: 在剖面上各加入一次偏心、傾斜及膠層不均，保持其他條件不變。畫出可能的光束偏轉或界面問題，並把膠合型與空氣間隔型設計分開記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Introduce decentration, tilt and uneven cement separately in a cross-section while holding other conditions fixed. Sketch beam deviation or interface issues and record cemented and air-spaced designs separately.
steps.observation: 裝配誤差可能呈現左右不對稱，不能只用軸上單點焦距判斷。
steps.observationEn: Assembly error can create asymmetry that one on-axis focal-length value misses.
steps.failure: 把空氣間隔直接替換為膠層會改變光學模型，不是單純更換固定方式。
steps.failureEn: Replacing an air gap with cement changes the optical model, not just the mounting method.
steps.check: 列出至少一項幾何與一項界面材料的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Identify at least one geometric and one interface-material verification.

knowledge.title: 共同光軸
knowledge.text: 雙片的相對光軸與傾角影響組合後的表現。
knowledge.textEn: Relative element axes and tilt affect the assembled performance.

knowledge.title: 界面介質
knowledge.text: 膠層或空氣間隙具有光學角色，應納入設計資料。
knowledge.textEn: Cement or an air gap has an optical role and belongs in the design data.

quiz.question: 將空氣間隔雙片直接膠合，為何需重新評估？
quiz.questionEn: Why reassess an air-spaced pair before cementing it?
options: 膠合只改變固定方式，不必修改任何光學模型。
界面介質與間距已改變。
只要兩片外徑相同，空氣與膠層可完全互換。
optionsEn: Cementing changes only mounting and requires no optical-model change.
Interface medium and spacing change.
Equal diameters make air and cement fully interchangeable.
quiz.explanation: 界面介質與間距已改變。 雙片的相對光軸與傾角影響組合後的表現。
quiz.explanationEn: Interface medium and spacing change. Relative element axes and tilt affect the assembled performance.

stages.title: 公差與驗收
stages.description: 把鍍膜、製造差異與多波長量測整合成可追溯驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Combine coatings, manufacturing variation and multiwavelength measurements in traceable acceptance.

steps.title: 區分抗反射鍍膜與色差修正
steps.titleEn: Separate antireflection coating from chromatic correction
steps.objective: 避免將透光率改善誤當作焦移消除。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mistaking improved transmission for eliminated focal shift.
steps.instruction: 在同一透鏡模型上比較有無抗反射鍍膜的光能路徑，另保留多波長焦點位置圖。分開記錄透射、反射鬼影與焦距，不用亮度替代成像量測。
steps.instructionEn: Compare light-energy paths with and without an antireflection coating while retaining a separate multicolor focus diagram. Record transmission, reflected ghosts and focal position independently.
steps.observation: 影像變亮或反光減少，不必然代表色差已降低。
steps.observationEn: A brighter image or reduced reflection does not necessarily indicate lower chromatic aberration.
steps.failure: 超出鍍膜設計波段的表現不可從單一波長外推。
steps.failureEn: Do not extrapolate one wavelength’s coating performance beyond its design band.
steps.check: 驗收表分開列出光譜透射與多色焦移。
steps.checkEn: Separate spectral transmission and multicolor focus shift in acceptance records.

knowledge.title: 反射與折射
knowledge.text: 抗反射鍍膜主要控制界面反射；雙合材料配置負責主要色差平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Antireflection coatings primarily control interface reflection; doublet material allocation provides the main chromatic balance.

knowledge.title: 亮度誤判
knowledge.text: 亮度受到光源與曝光影響，不能單獨代表解析品質。
knowledge.textEn: Brightness depends on illumination and exposure and is not an independent measure of resolution.

quiz.question: 鍍膜後影像更亮，是否足以證明兩色焦點更接近？
quiz.questionEn: The coated lens produces a brighter image. Does that prove closer two-color focus?
options: 足夠，較高透射率必然代表較小軸向色差。
足夠，只要鍍膜顏色符合設計波段。
不足，需另測多波長焦點。
optionsEn: Yes; higher transmission necessarily means smaller axial color.
Yes, if the coating’s visible color matches the design band.
No; multiwavelength focus needs separate measurement.
quiz.explanation: 不足，需另測多波長焦點。 抗反射鍍膜主要控制界面反射；雙合材料配置負責主要色差平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: No; multiwavelength focus needs separate measurement. Antireflection coatings primarily control interface reflection; doublet material allocation provides the main chromatic balance.

steps.title: 建立尺寸與材料的公差敏感度
steps.titleEn: Build tolerance sensitivity for geometry and glass
steps.objective: 找出值得優先控制的設計變因。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify design variables that deserve priority control.
steps.instruction: 建立曲率、厚度、間距、折射率與偏心五欄。用模型或來源資料逐一施加小變化，記錄焦位或影像指標的變化方向；明確註明不是工廠統計分布。
steps.instructionEn: Create columns for curvature, thickness, spacing, refractive index and decentration. Apply small changes individually in a model or referenced data and record response direction, explicitly distinguishing this from factory statistics.
steps.observation: 相同百分比變化對不同變因，不一定造成相同影像影響。
steps.observationEn: Equal percentage changes in different variables need not produce equal image effects.
steps.failure: 把單因子結果直接相加成量產良率會超出資料能力。
steps.failureEn: Turning one-factor results directly into production yield exceeds the evidence.
steps.check: 指出最敏感的候選變因及其比較尺度，保留尚未評估的耦合。
steps.checkEn: Identify candidate sensitive variables and comparison scales while retaining untested couplings.

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: 公差評估關心輸入偏差如何傳到成像結果。
knowledge.textEn: Tolerance analysis asks how input deviations propagate into imaging results.

knowledge.title: 分布假設
knowledge.text: 良率推估另需合理的製造分布及變因相關性。
knowledge.textEn: Yield estimates additionally need defensible manufacturing distributions and correlations.

quiz.question: 只有單因子敏感度表，能否直接宣稱量產良率？
quiz.questionEn: Can a one-factor sensitivity table directly establish production yield?
options: 不能，仍缺製造分布和相關性資料。
能，把各變因造成的偏差百分比平均即可。
能，單因子分析已包含變因之間的相關性。
optionsEn: No; manufacturing distributions and correlations are missing.
Yes; average the deviation percentages from all variables.
Yes; one-factor analysis already includes inter-variable correlations.
quiz.explanation: 不能，仍缺製造分布和相關性資料。 公差評估關心輸入偏差如何傳到成像結果。
quiz.explanationEn: No; manufacturing distributions and correlations are missing. Tolerance analysis asks how input deviations propagate into imaging results.

steps.title: 比較多波長焦點與離軸影像
steps.titleEn: Compare multicolor focus and off-axis images
steps.objective: 用一致條件檢查軸上與視場邊緣。
steps.objectiveEn: Check on-axis and field-edge behavior under consistent conditions.
steps.instruction: 用紙上光線模型或自行取得的合適測量資料，固定物體、光圈與參考位置；分別記錄指定波長的最佳焦位，再在共同像面比較中心和邊緣。
steps.instructionEn: Using a paper ray model or suitable measurements you obtain, hold object, aperture and reference position fixed. Record best focus for each wavelength, then compare center and edge at one common image plane.
steps.observation: 各色各自重新對焦可掩蓋共同像面上的實際色差。
steps.observationEn: Refocusing separately for each color can hide the actual chromatic error at a shared image plane.
steps.failure: 更改曝光或物距而未記錄，會破壞不同影像之間的比較。
steps.failureEn: Unrecorded exposure or object-distance changes undermine comparisons.
steps.check: 結果同時包含各色最佳焦位與共同像面表現。
steps.checkEn: Include both per-color best-focus positions and common-plane performance.

knowledge.title: 共同條件比較
knowledge.text: 驗收需與實際使用條件一致，不能為每個結果換一組最佳條件。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance should match use conditions rather than optimize conditions independently for each result.

knowledge.title: 視場取樣
knowledge.text: 軸上良好不保證離軸同樣良好。
knowledge.textEn: Good on-axis performance does not guarantee good off-axis performance.

quiz.question: 為每種顏色各自重新對焦後都很清楚，還缺什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Every color is sharp after separate refocusing. What evidence is missing?
options: 只比較各色在自己的最佳像面所得影像。
在同一像面上的多色比較。
只比較總透光率，無需保留焦位差。
optionsEn: Compare each color only at its own best image plane.
A multicolor comparison at one image plane.
Compare total transmission without retaining focus offsets.
quiz.explanation: 在同一像面上的多色比較。 驗收需與實際使用條件一致，不能為每個結果換一組最佳條件。
quiz.explanationEn: A multicolor comparison at one image plane. Acceptance should match use conditions rather than optimize conditions independently for each result.

steps.title: 整理光學組件的驗收與追溯
steps.titleEn: Assemble optical acceptance and traceability
steps.objective: 讓材料、設計版本與實測條件可互相對應。
steps.objectiveEn: Link materials, design revision and measurement conditions.
steps.instruction: 把玻璃資料、表面順序、方向、公差與成像結果組成一份交接表。加入一個可接受殘差與一個超限案例，分別寫出接受理由及需要改善的變因。
steps.instructionEn: Combine glass data, surface order, orientation, tolerances and imaging results in a handoff record. Add an acceptable residual and an out-of-limit case, stating acceptance reasoning and the variable to investigate.
steps.observation: 聲稱「完全不散色」通常超出有限波段與有限公差的證據。
steps.observationEn: A claim of absolutely no dispersion generally exceeds evidence limited by spectrum and tolerances.
steps.failure: 若測試版本與製造圖面不同，先修正版本對應再作判定。
steps.failureEn: If tested and manufactured revisions differ, restore revision correspondence before judgment.
steps.check: 交付文件說明適用波段、殘餘像差、組裝方向及未驗證條件。
steps.checkEn: State the applicable band, residual aberrations, mounting orientation and unverified conditions.

knowledge.title: 規格化性能
knowledge.text: 工程驗收依明確條件下的性能，而不是無限範圍的完美宣稱。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering acceptance uses performance under stated conditions rather than unlimited perfection claims.

knowledge.title: 版本控制
knowledge.text: 材料批次、設計處方與測試條件需可追溯到同一組件。
knowledge.textEn: Material lot, prescription and test conditions should trace to the same assembly.

quiz.question: 哪個交付描述最可驗證？
quiz.questionEn: Which delivery statement is most verifiable?
options: 在未指定波段下，單一焦距正確即代表全面合格。
外徑與中心厚度合格即可取代所有成像驗收。
在列明波段與共軛下符合指定焦移和成像要求。
optionsEn: Correct focal length alone proves complete compliance without a specified spectrum.
Diameter and center-thickness compliance replace all imaging acceptance.
Meets stated focus-shift and imaging requirements over the listed band and conjugates.
quiz.explanation: 在列明波段與共軛下符合指定焦移和成像要求。 工程驗收依明確條件下的性能，而不是無限範圍的完美宣稱。
quiz.explanationEn: Meets stated focus-shift and imaging requirements over the listed band and conjugates. Engineering acceptance uses performance under stated conditions rather than unlimited perfection claims.

courses.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied.

courses.title: 安全啟動與韌體信任鏈
courses.titleEn: Secure boot and firmware chains of trust
courses.summary: 從信任根、映像驗證與金鑰權限，建立能拒絕未授權啟動、處理更新並保留可信復原路徑的設計。
courses.summaryEn: Design a boot chain with roots of trust, image verification, key authority, authenticated updates and a trusted recovery path.

stages.title: 信任架構
stages.description: 盤點啟動路徑與授權，不把所有韌體保護都等同 UEFI Secure Boot。
stages.descriptionEn: Inventory boot paths and authority without equating all firmware protection with UEFI Secure Boot.

steps.title: 盤點啟動元件與信任邊界
steps.titleEn: Inventory boot components and trust boundaries
steps.objective: 畫出韌體、載入器、核心及每次驗證先於執行的邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Map firmware, loader and kernel with verification boundaries before execution.
steps.instruction: 在隔離的紙上模型排列信任根、平台韌體、UEFI 載入器與作業系統核心。為每次交接標明驗證者、被驗證資料與失敗處置；把硬體韌體保護與 UEFI 映像政策分開。
steps.instructionEn: In an isolated paper model, order the root of trust, platform firmware, UEFI loader and OS kernel. Label verifier, verified data and failure handling at each handoff, separating firmware protection from UEFI image policy.
steps.observation: 沒有驗證的交接點，不能只因前一段可信就宣稱後一段可信。
steps.observationEn: An unverified handoff does not become trusted merely because its predecessor is trusted.
steps.failure: 把「已開啟 Secure Boot」視為所有裝置韌體都受保護，會漏掉範圍外元件。
steps.failureEn: Treating enabled Secure Boot as protection for every device firmware overlooks components outside its scope.
steps.check: 每條執行箭頭前都有對應驗證或明確列出的架構假設。
steps.checkEn: Precede every execution edge with verification or an explicitly recorded architectural assumption.

knowledge.title: 信任鏈
knowledge.text: 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

knowledge.title: 保護範圍
knowledge.text: UEFI 映像驗證與平台全部韌體的完整性是相關但不同的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI image verification and integrity of all platform firmware are related but distinct scopes.

quiz.question: 載入器可信，是否足以直接執行任何未驗證核心？
quiz.questionEn: Does a trusted loader justify executing any unverified kernel?
options: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。
足夠，前一段可信就等同所有後續輸入都受授權。
足夠，只要核心雜湊由該核心自己宣告即可。
optionsEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy.
Yes; trust in the previous stage authorizes all subsequent inputs.
Yes; the kernel only needs to declare its own hash.
quiz.explanation: 不足，下一段仍需依其信任政策驗證。 信任需要逐段建立，並以受保護的起點作基礎。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the next stage still needs verification under its trust policy. Trust is established across successive stages from a protected starting point.

steps.title: 定義信任根與受保護狀態
steps.titleEn: Define roots of trust and protected state
steps.objective: 辨認不能由待驗證軟體自行改寫的信任依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify trust evidence that unverified software cannot rewrite at will.
steps.instruction: 在架構圖標出驗證程式、信任金鑰、版本狀態與復原根。對每項提出「誰能修改」及「修改如何授權」兩個問題，使用假設權限表而不操作真實韌體。
steps.instructionEn: Mark verifier code, trust keys, version state and recovery roots. For each, ask who can modify it and how changes are authorized, using a hypothetical permission table rather than modifying real firmware.
steps.observation: 若被驗證映像也能任意替換驗證金鑰，信任會形成循環。
steps.observationEn: If the image under review can freely replace its verification key, trust becomes circular.
steps.failure: 僅把金鑰檔案命名為 root 並不提供保護；需說明保護機制。
steps.failureEn: Naming a key file root provides no protection; explain the protection mechanism.
steps.check: 每個信任依據都有保護位置、修改權限與授權路徑。
steps.checkEn: Give each trust anchor a protected location, modification authority and authorization path.

knowledge.title: 信任起點
knowledge.text: 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
knowledge.textEn: A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

knowledge.title: 受控更新
knowledge.text: 可更新的信任資料仍需要明確、受驗證的變更規則。
knowledge.textEn: Updatable trust data still need explicit authenticated change rules.

quiz.question: 若未驗證映像可以替換自己的信任金鑰，問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is wrong if an unverified image can replace its own trust key?
options: 只要更換後的金鑰格式正確，就不影響安全。
它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。
金鑰可修改代表系統自動具備安全更新能力。
optionsEn: A correctly formatted replacement key cannot affect security.
It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary.
A modifiable key automatically provides secure update capability.
quiz.explanation: 它可自行建立接受自己的依據，破壞信任邊界。 信任根的可靠性不能完全依賴它所驗證的軟體。
quiz.explanationEn: It can manufacture its own acceptance basis, breaking the trust boundary. A root’s reliability cannot depend entirely on the software it verifies.

steps.title: 區分 PK、KEK、db 與 dbx
steps.titleEn: Separate PK, KEK, db and dbx
steps.objective: 把平台所有權、政策更新與映像允許權限分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate platform ownership, policy updates and image authorization.
steps.instruction: 建立四張權限卡，分別對應平台金鑰、金鑰交換金鑰、允許資料庫與禁止資料庫。用箭頭表示誰能授權更新哪個資料庫，另畫執行映像的判斷路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Create cards for PK, KEK, the allowed database and the forbidden database. Draw policy-update authorization arrows separately from the path used to decide whether an image executes.
steps.observation: 可以授權更新資料庫的金鑰，不等於自動允許所有由它簽署的執行映像。
steps.observationEn: A key authorized to update a database does not automatically authorize every executable it signs.
steps.failure: 把 PK 當成每個作業系統映像唯一簽署者，會混淆管理權與執行權。
steps.failureEn: Treating PK as the sole signer of every OS image confuses policy management with execution authorization.
steps.check: 能用一張圖區分金鑰管理與映像驗證兩條路徑。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish key-management and image-verification paths in one diagram.

knowledge.title: 權限分工
knowledge.text: UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
knowledge.textEn: UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

knowledge.title: 最小授權
knowledge.text: 一種權限不能被推定為所有其他權限。
knowledge.textEn: One form of authority must not be assumed to grant every other authority.

quiz.question: KEK 的主要角色較接近哪個描述？
quiz.questionEn: Which description best matches the role of KEK?
options: 直接提供所有作業系統核心的執行允許清單。
記錄裝置目前韌體的量測雜湊。
授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。
optionsEn: Directly serving as the execution allow list for every OS kernel.
Recording measured hashes of the current device firmware.
Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases.
quiz.explanation: 授權相關安全啟動資料庫的更新。 UEFI 政策將平台控制、政策更新及映像信任資料分成不同角色。
quiz.explanationEn: Authorizing updates to the relevant Secure Boot databases. UEFI policy separates platform control, policy updates and image trust data into distinct roles.

steps.title: 比較雜湊完整性與簽章授權
steps.titleEn: Compare hash integrity and signature authorization
steps.objective: 區分內容識別與可信發布者的判定。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish content identification from trusted-publisher authorization.
steps.instruction: 在紙上為原始映像與修改一位元的映像各指定不同雜湊，再加入可信與未知簽署者兩種卡片。分別判斷內容是否一致、簽章是否可驗證及簽署者是否受政策信任。
steps.instructionEn: Assign distinct hypothetical hashes to an original image and a one-bit modification, then add trusted and unknown signer cards. Separately judge content integrity, signature verification and policy trust in the signer.
steps.observation: 可算出雜湊，不代表該雜湊來自可信來源；簽章可驗證也仍需政策授權。
steps.observationEn: Computing a hash does not establish its trusted origin; a verifiable signature still needs policy authorization.
steps.failure: 從同一未知來源下載映像與雜湊，不能單靠兩者一致建立發布者信任。
steps.failureEn: An image and hash from the same unknown source do not establish publisher trust simply by matching.
steps.check: 每個接受結論同時說明內容驗證與信任來源。
steps.checkEn: Explain both integrity verification and trust provenance for each acceptance decision.

knowledge.title: 不同問題
knowledge.text: 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
knowledge.textEn: Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.

knowledge.title: 私鑰保管
knowledge.text: 發布簽署私鑰不應隨待驗證映像交付給裝置作一般資料。
knowledge.textEn: A release-signing private key should not be distributed as ordinary data alongside the image it authenticates.

quiz.question: 映像和未知網站提供的雜湊一致，能證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: An image matches a hash from an unknown website. What does that prove?
options: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。
已證明該網站是受授權的韌體發布者。
已證明此版本符合目前的撤銷與防回滾政策。
optionsEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established.
It proves the website is an authorized firmware publisher.
It proves compliance with current revocation and rollback policies.
quiz.explanation: 兩者在內容識別上相符，仍未建立可信發布者。 雜湊描述內容，簽章與信任政策協助判斷授權來源。
quiz.explanationEn: They agree as content identifiers, but a trusted publisher is not established. Hashes characterize content; signatures and trust policy help determine authorized origin.

stages.title: 驗證與更新
stages.description: 推演允許、拒絕、模式與版本政策的不同效果。
stages.descriptionEn: Model allow/deny decisions, modes and version policies separately.

steps.title: 推演允許與撤銷的判斷順序
steps.titleEn: Model allowed and revoked-image decisions
steps.objective: 理解明確撤銷不能被一般允許條目蓋過。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why explicit revocation cannot be overridden by ordinary allowance.
steps.instruction: 建立三個基本案例：受信任且未撤銷、未知簽署者、映像雜湊明確列入 dbx。逐一走過驗證流程，在最後一例保留原本受信任的簽署者以檢查撤銷效果。
