steps.instructionEn: Create basic cases for a trusted unrevoked image, an unknown signer and an image hash explicitly listed in dbx. Keep the last image’s signer otherwise trusted to test revocation independently.
steps.observation: 曾經可啟動的映像，在政策撤銷後可能需要被拒絕。
steps.observationEn: A previously bootable image may need rejection after policy revocation.
steps.failure: 把成功驗證簽章當成唯一通行證，會漏掉禁止資料庫的限制。
steps.failureEn: Treating signature verification as the only pass condition overlooks forbidden-database restrictions.
steps.check: 三個案例有清楚接受或拒絕結果，並標出所使用的政策版本。
steps.checkEn: Record a clear allow/deny outcome and policy revision for each case.

knowledge.title: 撤銷的用途
knowledge.text: 有效簽章不代表映像永遠適合被信任。
knowledge.textEn: A valid signature does not make an image suitable for trust forever.

knowledge.title: 政策版本
knowledge.text: 同一映像的判斷可因信任資料更新而改變。
knowledge.textEn: The decision on one image can change when trust data are updated.

quiz.question: 映像簽章有效，但其雜湊明確列入 dbx 的基本案例應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: A signature is valid but the image hash is explicitly in dbx. What should this basic case do?
options: 忽略 dbx，因為簽章曾經有效。
依禁止政策拒絕該映像。
把 dbx 當作允許清單。
optionsEn: Ignore dbx because the signature was once valid.
Reject the image under the forbidden policy.
Treat dbx as an allow list.
quiz.explanation: 依禁止政策拒絕該映像。 有效簽章不代表映像永遠適合被信任。
quiz.explanationEn: Reject the image under the forbidden policy. A valid signature does not make an image suitable for trust forever.

steps.title: 區分設定模式與強制驗證狀態
steps.titleEn: Distinguish provisioning mode from enforcement
steps.objective: 避免把政策已寫入誤當安全啟動已強制執行。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid equating enrolled policy data with active enforcement.
steps.instruction: 使用假設狀態表記錄 SetupMode、SecureBoot 與已配置信任資料。比較初始佈建、正常強制驗證及維修例外三種情境；只作模型判讀，不變更本機設定。
steps.instructionEn: Use a hypothetical state table for SetupMode, SecureBoot and enrolled trust data. Compare provisioning, normal enforcement and a maintenance exception without changing this device’s settings.
steps.observation: 有金鑰資料與目前實際強制驗證，是需要分開確認的證據。
steps.observationEn: Presence of key data and current verification enforcement require separate confirmation.
steps.failure: 僅截取一張金鑰清單而不記錄執行狀態，可能錯認保護已生效。
steps.failureEn: A key-list screenshot without enforcement state can falsely imply protection is active.
steps.check: 能說明每個情境的權限和驗證狀態，例外有明確回復條件。
steps.checkEn: Explain authority and enforcement for each case, with explicit restoration conditions for exceptions.

knowledge.title: 狀態與資料
knowledge.text: 安全政策資料存在，不代表所有運作模式都相同。
knowledge.textEn: Security-policy data can exist while operating modes differ.

knowledge.title: 佈建邊界
knowledge.text: 初始化與部署後的變更規則需要明確區別。
knowledge.textEn: Initial provisioning and post-deployment change rules must be distinguished.

quiz.question: 看到 db 中有信任憑證，是否足以證明目前強制驗證已啟用？
quiz.questionEn: Does a trusted certificate in db prove enforcement is currently enabled?
options: 足夠，任何資料存在都會自動強制執行。
足夠，模式變數沒有用途。
不足，還需確認相關運作狀態。
optionsEn: Yes; any stored data automatically enforce themselves.
Yes; mode variables have no purpose.
No; the relevant operating state must also be confirmed.
quiz.explanation: 不足，還需確認相關運作狀態。 安全政策資料存在，不代表所有運作模式都相同。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the relevant operating state must also be confirmed. Security-policy data can exist while operating modes differ.

steps.title: 驗證先行與執行交接
steps.titleEn: Verify before handing over execution
steps.objective: 找出先執行後檢查的邏輯缺口。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the flaw in checking code after executing it.
steps.instruction: 將「讀入、驗證、政策判定、執行」排成狀態機，為失敗分支指定停止或可信復原。再故意交換驗證與執行的位置，說明這會讓哪個信任假設失效。
steps.instructionEn: Arrange read, verify, policy decision and execute into a state machine, with stop or trusted recovery on failure. Swap verification and execution deliberately and identify the broken trust assumption.
steps.observation: 記錄已執行程式的雜湊，不等於事先阻止未授權程式執行。
steps.observationEn: Recording a hash of executed code is not the same as preventing unauthorized execution beforehand.
steps.failure: 只有成功路徑而無失敗分支的流程圖，不能描述安全啟動的完整決策。
steps.failureEn: A success-only flowchart cannot describe the full secure-boot decision.
steps.check: 每個失敗狀態都不會直接跳到未驗證映像執行。
steps.checkEn: No failure state directly transfers control to an unverified image.

knowledge.title: 時間順序
knowledge.text: 驗證要保護執行交接，就必須在該交接前產生有效決定。
knowledge.textEn: Verification protects an execution handoff only when it establishes a valid decision before that handoff.

knowledge.title: 紀錄與阻擋
knowledge.text: 量測或稽核紀錄可補充證據，但不能假定等同阻擋機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measurement or audit records add evidence but must not be assumed equivalent to blocking.

quiz.question: 先執行映像、再驗證簽章的核心問題是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What is the central flaw in executing an image before verifying its signature?
options: 未授權內容可能已取得執行機會。
只影響開機速度，不影響未授權內容的執行。
事後驗證失敗可自動撤回所有已發生的執行效果。
optionsEn: Unauthorized content may already have executed.
It affects boot speed but not unauthorized execution.
Failed post-execution verification automatically reverses all prior execution effects.
quiz.explanation: 未授權內容可能已取得執行機會。 驗證要保護執行交接，就必須在該交接前產生有效決定。
quiz.explanationEn: Unauthorized content may already have executed. Verification protects an execution handoff only when it establishes a valid decision before that handoff.

steps.title: 分開更新授權與防回滾政策
steps.titleEn: Separate update authorization from rollback policy
steps.objective: 理解舊的合法簽章仍可能對應不應再用的版本。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that an old valid signature can identify an unsuitable version.
steps.instruction: 建立三個已簽署韌體版本的模型，其中一個已被產品政策淘汰。分別檢查簽署授權、映像完整性與版本下限，並註明防回滾是另外設計的機制。
steps.instructionEn: Model three signed firmware versions, one retired by product policy. Check signing authority, integrity and a minimum-version rule separately, explicitly treating rollback resistance as an additional mechanism.
steps.observation: 簽章是否有效與版本是否符合目前政策，可以得到不同答案。
steps.observationEn: Signature validity and current version-policy compliance can yield different answers.
steps.failure: 不能宣稱一般 UEFI Secure Boot 自動實作所有產品的版本計數器。
steps.failureEn: Do not claim generic UEFI Secure Boot automatically implements every product’s version counter.
steps.check: 更新表分別列出驗證、授權與版本決策，且描述例外復原的限制。
steps.checkEn: Separate verification, authorization and version decisions, including limits on recovery exceptions.

knowledge.title: 合法但過舊
knowledge.text: 映像曾由可信者發布，不代表今天仍應允許回復使用。
knowledge.textEn: A trusted past release is not necessarily acceptable to restore today.

knowledge.title: 版本狀態保護
knowledge.text: 若採用防回滾，最低版本等政策狀態也要受到保護。
knowledge.textEn: Rollback resistance also requires protection of policy state such as a minimum version.

quiz.question: 一個舊版簽章仍有效，最合理的下一步是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: An old version still has a valid signature. What is the reasonable next check?
options: 只檢查簽章數學上有效，就允許任何歷史版本。
確認目前版本與撤銷政策是否仍允許。
只比較版本字串長度，不檢查受保護的版本政策。
optionsEn: Permit every historical version if its signature is mathematically valid.
Check whether current version and revocation policies still permit it.
Compare version-string length rather than protected version policy.
quiz.explanation: 確認目前版本與撤銷政策是否仍允許。 映像曾由可信者發布，不代表今天仍應允許回復使用。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whether current version and revocation policies still permit it. A trusted past release is not necessarily acceptable to restore today.

stages.title: 復原與發布
stages.description: 以失敗案例與金鑰變更檢查系統是否仍可可信復原。
stages.descriptionEn: Use failures and key transitions to verify that trusted recovery remains possible.

steps.title: 設計金鑰輪替與撤銷順序
steps.titleEn: Plan key rotation and revocation order
steps.objective: 維持新舊發布與復原映像的相容過渡。
steps.objectiveEn: Maintain a compatible transition for releases and recovery images.
steps.instruction: 在時間線放置新增信任金鑰、更新啟動與復原映像、驗證部署結果及撤銷舊信任四件事。用離線或延遲更新裝置的案例，找出會使裝置無可信映像可啟動的排序。
steps.instructionEn: Place new trust enrollment, boot and recovery image updates, deployment verification and old-trust revocation on a timeline. Include delayed or offline devices to find sequences that leave no trusted bootable image.
steps.observation: 只更新日常啟動映像而忘記復原媒體，可能留下未來復原失效。
steps.observationEn: Updating the normal boot image but forgetting recovery media can create a later recovery failure.
steps.failure: 過早撤銷而沒有可用替代映像，不能靠重啟次數修正。
steps.failureEn: Premature revocation without a usable replacement cannot be repaired by repeated restarts.
steps.check: 輪替計畫涵蓋試點、延遲裝置、復原媒體及明確停止條件。
steps.checkEn: Cover pilot devices, delayed devices, recovery media and explicit stop criteria.

knowledge.title: 過渡相容性
knowledge.text: 金鑰政策與可啟動映像必須以相容順序更新。
knowledge.textEn: Key policy and bootable images must be updated in a compatible order.

knowledge.title: 簽署職責
knowledge.text: 發布、授權與私鑰保管職責應被明確分配。
knowledge.textEn: Release, authorization and private-key custody need explicit responsibility assignments.

quiz.question: 撤銷舊信任前，哪項檢查最直接避免無法啟動？
quiz.questionEn: Which check most directly avoids unbootable devices before old trust is revoked?
options: 只確認新金鑰已產生，不檢查裝置是否信任它。
只更新正常啟動映像，復原映像與輪替無關。
確認目標裝置與復原路徑已有受新政策接受的映像。
optionsEn: Confirm only that the new key exists, not whether devices trust it.
Update only normal boot images; recovery images are unrelated to rotation.
Confirm target devices and recovery paths have images accepted by the new policy.
quiz.explanation: 確認目標裝置與復原路徑已有受新政策接受的映像。 金鑰政策與可啟動映像必須以相容順序更新。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm target devices and recovery paths have images accepted by the new policy. Key policy and bootable images must be updated in a compatible order.

steps.title: 建立可信復原而非任意回退
steps.titleEn: Design trusted recovery rather than arbitrary fallback
steps.objective: 確保恢復可用性不破壞完整性。
steps.objectiveEn: Restore availability without abandoning integrity.
steps.instruction: 在狀態圖加入主映像損壞、更新中斷與復原映像不受信任三種案例。為每種指定可驗證的復原來源和失敗出口，不把「任意舊檔」當成保證成功的備份。
steps.instructionEn: Add cases for a corrupt primary image, interrupted update and untrusted recovery image. Specify an authenticated recovery source and failure exit for each rather than treating any old file as a guaranteed backup.
steps.observation: 復原映像本身及其授權路徑也需要保護。
steps.observationEn: Recovery images and their authorization path also need protection.
steps.failure: 為了開機而跳過復原驗證，可能把故障處理變成信任繞過。
steps.failureEn: Skipping recovery verification merely to boot can turn fault handling into a trust bypass.
steps.check: 每條復原路徑都說明信任依據、版本政策與失敗時的處置。
steps.checkEn: State the trust basis, version policy and failure handling for every recovery path.

knowledge.title: 韌性三部分
knowledge.text: 韌體韌性結合保護、偵測與可信復原。
knowledge.textEn: Firmware resilience combines protection, detection and trusted recovery.

knowledge.title: 可用性與完整性
knowledge.text: 恢復運作仍須保持授權與完整性，兩者不是互斥選項。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring operation should preserve authorization and integrity rather than discard them.

quiz.question: 主映像損壞時，哪種復原做法符合信任設計？
quiz.questionEn: Which recovery approach preserves trust after the primary image is corrupted?
options: 驗證復原映像和其授權，再依政策恢復。
執行第一個找到的未知映像。
把所有簽章檢查永久關閉。
optionsEn: Verify the recovery image and authorization, then recover under policy.
Execute the first unknown image found.
Permanently disable every signature check.
quiz.explanation: 驗證復原映像和其授權，再依政策恢復。 韌體韌性結合保護、偵測與可信復原。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify the recovery image and authorization, then recover under policy. Firmware resilience combines protection, detection and trusted recovery.

steps.title: 建立拒絕案例與中斷案例矩陣
steps.titleEn: Build rejection and interruption test cases
steps.objective: 證明失敗路徑也符合設計意圖。
steps.objectiveEn: Show that failure paths also meet the design intent.
steps.instruction: 只在隔離模型列出內容遭修改、未知簽署者、明確撤銷、過舊版本及更新中斷五種案例。對每例預先寫下預期結果，再記錄模型的實際決策與差異。
steps.instructionEn: In an isolated model only, list modified content, an unknown signer, explicit revocation, an obsolete version and interrupted update. Write expected outcomes before recording modeled decisions and discrepancies.
steps.observation: 成功啟動一次不能替代拒絕未授權內容的測試。
steps.observationEn: One successful boot cannot replace tests that reject unauthorized content.
steps.failure: 測試後才改寫預期值以符合結果，會使驗證失去意義。
steps.failureEn: Rewriting expectations afterward to match outcomes makes verification meaningless.
steps.check: 矩陣含預期、觀察、政策版本與差異處置，且不接觸生產裝置。
steps.checkEn: Include expected outcome, observation, policy revision and discrepancy handling without touching production devices.

knowledge.title: 負向測試
knowledge.text: 安全功能需要證明應拒絕的輸入被正確拒絕。
knowledge.textEn: A security function must demonstrate correct rejection of inputs that should be denied.

knowledge.title: 事先判據
knowledge.text: 先寫預期結果，才能辨認實作與設計的差異。
knowledge.textEn: Defining expected outcomes first makes implementation discrepancies visible.

quiz.question: 所有合法映像都能啟動，是否代表拒絕機制已驗證？
quiz.questionEn: All legitimate images boot. Does that verify the rejection mechanism?
options: 有，允許清單運作就能推定禁止清單正確。
沒有，仍須測試應拒絕的案例。
有，因為沒有發現啟動失敗就代表所有拒絕路徑正確。
optionsEn: Yes; a working allow list proves the deny list works.
No; cases that should be rejected still need testing.
Yes; no observed boot failures proves every rejection path correct.
quiz.explanation: 沒有，仍須測試應拒絕的案例。 安全功能需要證明應拒絕的輸入被正確拒絕。
quiz.explanationEn: No; cases that should be rejected still need testing. A security function must demonstrate correct rejection of inputs that should be denied.

steps.title: 交付發布清單與可稽核證據
steps.titleEn: Deliver release inventory and auditable evidence
steps.objective: 讓裝置狀態、信任政策與復原能力可追溯。
steps.objectiveEn: Make device state, trust policy and recovery capability traceable.
steps.instruction: 整理元件清單、信任角色、版本政策、測試矩陣與復原演練結果。為小批試點和大批部署各設一個停止條件，說明收到異常結果時如何保留證據與暫停推進。
steps.instructionEn: Assemble component inventory, trust roles, version policy, test matrix and recovery-exercise results. Define a stop criterion for pilot and wider rollout, preserving evidence and pausing progression on anomalies.
steps.observation: 文件應能回答哪台裝置、哪版政策、哪個映像與哪次驗證，而不只寫「安全」。
steps.observationEn: Records should identify device, policy revision, image and verification event rather than simply say secure.
steps.failure: 分享稽核資料時不應把簽署私鑰混入交付附件。
steps.failureEn: Audit deliverables must not accidentally include signing private keys.
steps.check: 交付包包含可讀證據與限制，沒有宣稱模型測試等同整個平台安全認證。
steps.checkEn: Deliver readable evidence and limitations without equating model tests with complete platform certification.

knowledge.title: 可追溯發布
knowledge.text: 發布決定需要連接映像身分、授權與實際驗證結果。
knowledge.textEn: Release decisions should connect image identity, authorization and observed verification results.

knowledge.title: 範圍誠實
knowledge.text: 啟動信任是系統防護的一部分，不涵蓋所有執行期漏洞。
knowledge.textEn: Boot trust is one part of system protection and does not cover every runtime vulnerability.

quiz.question: 哪份紀錄最能支持可信交付？
quiz.questionEn: Which record best supports a trustworthy handoff?
options: 只有一張成功開機畫面，未記錄政策與映像版本。
只有映像雜湊清單，未連接裝置、授權與復原測試。
裝置、映像、政策版本、測試結果與復原限制的對應表。
optionsEn: Only a successful-boot screenshot with no policy or image revision.
Only image hashes without links to devices, authorization or recovery tests.
A mapping of devices, images, policy revisions, test results and recovery limitations.
quiz.explanation: 裝置、映像、政策版本、測試結果與復原限制的對應表。 發布決定需要連接映像身分、授權與實際驗證結果。
quiz.explanationEn: A mapping of devices, images, policy revisions, test results and recovery limitations. Release decisions should connect image identity, authorization and observed verification results.

courses.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。 僅使用隔離的架構與狀態模型；不變更使用者裝置的金鑰、韌體或安全啟動設定。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied. Uses isolated architecture and state models only; does not change device keys, firmware or Secure Boot settings.

courses.title: 大型電力變壓器製造
courses.summary: 以不通電的圖面與報告判讀，串連變比、鐵心、繞組、絕緣、乾燥、冷卻及工廠驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Connect ratio, core, windings, insulation, drying, cooling and factory acceptance using de-energized schematics and report interpretation.

stages.title: 電磁需求與主動部件
stages.description: 將額定需求轉成鐵心、繞組與損失的設計問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Translate ratings into core, winding and loss considerations.

steps.title: 界定變比、容量與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Define ratio, rating and system boundary
steps.objective: 區分電壓比、容量、頻率與冷卻條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish voltage ratio, power rating, frequency and cooling conditions.
steps.instruction: 畫出一次側、磁心、二次側與冷卻系統，在紙上名牌分別填入明確假設的電壓比、容量與頻率。比較兩台變比相同但容量不同的設備，說明為何不能互換使用。
steps.instructionEn: Draw primary, core, secondary and cooling system. Enter explicitly hypothetical ratio, rating and frequency on a paper nameplate, then compare equal-ratio units with different ratings and explain why they are not interchangeable.
steps.observation: 相同變比不代表具有相同導體尺寸、散熱能力或絕緣配置。
steps.observationEn: Equal ratio does not imply equal conductor size, cooling capability or insulation arrangement.
steps.failure: 把電壓比當作全部規格，會漏掉電流、熱及系統條件。
steps.failureEn: Treating voltage ratio as the complete specification omits current, thermal and system conditions.
steps.check: 需求表分開列明變比、額定能力、頻率及使用環境假設。
steps.checkEn: Record ratio, rated capability, frequency and environmental assumptions separately.

knowledge.title: 額定條件
knowledge.text: 額定能力必須連同適用條件解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Rated capability must be interpreted with its applicable conditions.

knowledge.title: 系統邊界
knowledge.text: 主動部件、絕緣與冷卻共同限制可用能力。
knowledge.textEn: Active parts, insulation and cooling jointly constrain usable capability.

quiz.question: 兩台變壓器變比相同，能否直接互換？
quiz.questionEn: Can equal-ratio transformers be exchanged without further review?
options: 不能，還需核對容量、頻率、絕緣及系統條件。
能，變比相同代表額定電流也必然相同。
能，兩台只要具有相同端子數便完全相容。
optionsEn: No; rating, frequency, insulation and system conditions still need checking.
Yes; equal ratio guarantees equal current ratings.
Yes; equal terminal count establishes full compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需核對容量、頻率、絕緣及系統條件。 額定能力必須連同適用條件解讀。
quiz.explanationEn: No; rating, frequency, insulation and system conditions still need checking. Rated capability must be interpreted with its applicable conditions.

steps.title: 用理想模型核對匝數比與功率
steps.titleEn: Check turns ratio and power in an ideal model
steps.objective: 理解升壓與電流變化的對應，而不把理想結果當額定設計。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate voltage transformation to current without treating an ideal result as rated design.
steps.instruction: 在紙上假設匝數比 10:1、一次電壓 100 V，推得理想二次電壓 10 V。再假設功率因數為 1 的理想輸出 100 W，求兩側電流並檢查功率平衡；這些只作算術，不接線通電。
steps.instructionEn: On paper, assume a 10:1 turns ratio and 100 V primary to obtain 10 V ideally. Assume 100 W ideal output at unity power factor, calculate both currents and check power balance; perform no wiring or energization.
steps.observation: 降壓時理想二次電流增加，並不是憑空產生更多功率。
steps.observationEn: In step-down operation, ideal secondary current increases without creating extra power.
steps.failure: 將電壓與電流比同方向套用會破壞能量平衡。
steps.failureEn: Applying voltage and current ratios in the same direction breaks the ideal power balance.
steps.check: 得到一次 1 A、二次 10 A，並列出損失與激磁尚未納入。
steps.checkEn: Obtain 1 A primary and 10 A secondary and state that losses and excitation are omitted.

knowledge.title: 理想能量平衡
knowledge.text: 理想變壓器改變電壓與電流的比例，同時維持功率平衡。
knowledge.textEn: An ideal transformer changes voltage and current ratios while conserving power.

knowledge.title: 模型限制
knowledge.text: 實際設備有損失、激磁與熱限制，不能由匝數比推得所有額定能力。 此例電流試算另假設功率因數為 1。
knowledge.textEn: Real units have losses, excitation and thermal limits; turns ratio does not determine every rating. The current calculation also assumes unity power factor.

quiz.question: 本例理想二次電流為多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the ideal secondary current in this example?
quiz.explanation: 10 A。 理想變壓器改變電壓與電流的比例，同時維持功率平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: 10 A. An ideal transformer changes voltage and current ratios while conserving power.

steps.title: 辨認疊片磁心與磁路連續性
steps.titleEn: Identify a laminated core and magnetic path
steps.objective: 區分導磁路徑與導電短接風險。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish the magnetic path from unwanted conductive paths.
steps.instruction: 用原創截面畫出柱、軛與絕緣疊片，沿磁路追蹤一圈。比較整塊導電材料與薄片隔離的概念，並把接縫、缺口及裝配受力列為需由設計文件確認的項目。
steps.instructionEn: Draw limbs, yokes and insulated laminations and trace the magnetic path. Compare a solid conductive core with isolated sheets and list joints, gaps and assembly loads for review against the design documentation.
steps.observation: 層間絕緣與磁路連續具有不同目的，不能互相取代。
steps.observationEn: Interlaminar insulation and magnetic continuity serve different purposes.
steps.failure: 若把所有疊片用導電橋連成一體，不能只憑機械更牢固就判定改善。
steps.failureEn: Conductively bridging laminations cannot be judged beneficial merely because the structure appears stronger.
steps.check: 模型清楚標示磁路、疊片方向與應保護的層間狀態。
steps.checkEn: Mark the magnetic path, lamination orientation and interlaminar condition to preserve.

knowledge.title: 疊片作用
knowledge.text: 磁心使用分層電工鋼，以兼顧導磁與損失控制。
knowledge.textEn: Layered electrical steel supports magnetic flux while helping control losses.

knowledge.title: 接縫與機械
knowledge.text: 接縫配置與支撐須服從核准設計，不能由外觀任意改動。
knowledge.textEn: Joint layout and support follow an approved design, not arbitrary visual preference.

quiz.question: 為何不能把層間絕緣視為無關細節？
quiz.questionEn: Why is interlaminar insulation not a trivial detail?
options: 它只影響表面防鏽，不影響電磁損失。
只要磁心尺寸足夠，層間導電狀態便不重要。
它關係到不希望出現的導電路徑與損失。
optionsEn: It affects only corrosion protection, not electromagnetic loss.
Sufficient core size makes interlaminar conduction irrelevant.
It affects unwanted conductive paths and losses.
quiz.explanation: 它關係到不希望出現的導電路徑與損失。 磁心使用分層電工鋼，以兼顧導磁與損失控制。
quiz.explanationEn: It affects unwanted conductive paths and losses. Layered electrical steel supports magnetic flux while helping control losses.

steps.title: 比較繞組導體、電阻與熱負擔
steps.titleEn: Compare winding conductors, resistance and heat
steps.objective: 把電流路徑與熱產生連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect current paths to heat generation.
steps.instruction: 在繞組示意圖標出導體長度、截面與連接點。以相同電阻的假設比較電流 I 與 2I 的 I²R 損失，再指出實際設計還需考慮交流與散熱效應。
steps.instructionEn: Mark conductor length, cross-section and joints on a winding schematic. At hypothetical fixed resistance, compare I²R loss for I and 2I, then identify additional AC and cooling considerations in real design.
steps.observation: 局部接點電阻偏高可形成熱點，即使整體尺寸看起來合理。
steps.observationEn: Elevated local joint resistance can create a hotspot even when overall dimensions look reasonable.
steps.failure: 只用直流電阻估計所有交流損失會不完整；保留模型邊界。
steps.failureEn: DC resistance alone does not capture every AC loss; keep the model boundary explicit.
steps.check: 說明電流加倍的示例損失變成四倍，而非把它當作整機溫升預測。
steps.checkEn: Explain fourfold loss in the doubled-current example without claiming a full-unit temperature-rise prediction.

knowledge.title: 電阻熱
knowledge.text: 固定電阻的 I²R 模型顯示電流增加會更快增加熱負擔。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed resistance, I²R shows heat burden increasing faster than current.

knowledge.title: 熱點與平均
knowledge.text: 平均溫度不能保證局部接點沒有異常。
knowledge.textEn: An average temperature does not rule out abnormal local joints.

quiz.question: 固定電阻下電流加倍，電阻損失如何變化？
quiz.questionEn: With fixed resistance, how does resistive loss change when current doubles?
options: 變成四倍。
保持不變。
減為四分之一。
optionsEn: It becomes four times greater.
It stays unchanged.
It becomes one quarter.
quiz.explanation: 變成四倍。 固定電阻的 I²R 模型顯示電流增加會更快增加熱負擔。
quiz.explanationEn: It becomes four times greater. At fixed resistance, I²R shows heat burden increasing faster than current.

stages.title: 絕緣與機械整合
stages.description: 把絕緣、支撐、乾燥與油箱視為互相影響的系統。
stages.descriptionEn: Treat insulation, support, drying and tanking as interacting systems.

steps.title: 配置主絕緣、匝間絕緣與油隙
steps.titleEn: Map major insulation, turn insulation and oil gaps
steps.objective: 分辨不同電位之間的絕緣任務。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish insulation duties between different potentials.
steps.instruction: 在不通電的剖面模型為繞組、磁心與油箱標記相對電位，將匝間、繞組間及對地絕緣分色。比較改變間距對電場和空間配置的概念影響，不自行指定高壓耐受值。
steps.instructionEn: In a de-energized section, label relative potentials of windings, core and tank. Color turn, winding-to-winding and ground insulation separately and compare spacing effects without inventing high-voltage withstand ratings.
steps.observation: 同一厚度的材料處於不同幾何位置，可能承受不同局部電場。
steps.observationEn: Equal material thickness in different geometries can face different local electric fields.
steps.failure: 只增加某處間距而阻擋冷卻通道，可能改善一項卻損害另一項。
steps.failureEn: Increasing a clearance while obstructing cooling can improve one aspect and harm another.
steps.check: 標示各絕緣介面、其功能與需由正式設計確認的條件。
steps.checkEn: Mark each insulation interface, its function and conditions requiring formal design verification.

knowledge.title: 多介面絕緣
knowledge.text: 紙、壓板與絕緣液各承擔不同介面和支撐功能。
knowledge.textEn: Paper, pressboard and insulating liquid serve different interface and support functions.

knowledge.title: 電熱耦合
knowledge.text: 絕緣配置亦影響散熱及機械布局，不能只看單一間距。
knowledge.textEn: Insulation layout also affects cooling and mechanics, not just one clearance.

quiz.question: 增加絕緣距離時，還應共同檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What else should be checked when insulation spacing increases?
options: 只需重新計算匝數比，熱路徑不會受影響。
冷卻通道與機械布局是否受影響。
只要絕緣材料相同，機械與冷卻布局不需重查。
optionsEn: Recalculate only turns ratio; thermal paths cannot be affected.
Whether cooling paths and mechanical layout are affected.
Identical insulation material eliminates review of mechanical and cooling layout.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻通道與機械布局是否受影響。 紙、壓板與絕緣液各承擔不同介面和支撐功能。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether cooling paths and mechanical layout are affected. Paper, pressboard and insulating liquid serve different interface and support functions.

steps.title: 追蹤繞組支撐與力的傳遞
steps.titleEn: Trace winding support and load paths
steps.objective: 理解異常電流下的機械完整性需要設計驗證。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that mechanical integrity under abnormal current requires design verification.
steps.instruction: 在繞組、墊塊、夾件與支架示意圖畫出徑向和軸向受力路徑。比較支撐完整與缺少一處支撐的案例，指出哪些位移可能損害絕緣；不提供現場鎖固力矩。
steps.instructionEn: Draw radial and axial load paths through windings, spacers, clamps and supports. Compare complete support with one missing support and identify displacements that could damage insulation without prescribing tightening torque.
steps.observation: 外殼沒有明顯變形，不代表內部繞組位置沒有改變。
steps.observationEn: An unchanged enclosure does not prove unchanged internal winding positions.
steps.failure: 過度夾緊可能損害材料，不能以「越緊越安全」取代設計。
steps.failureEn: Excessive clamping can damage materials; tighter is safer cannot replace design.
steps.check: 每條受力路徑有明確支撐介面，未知強度列為待驗證。
steps.checkEn: Give each load path a defined support interface and mark unknown strength as unverified.

knowledge.title: 機電耦合
knowledge.text: 電流相關作用力與機械支撐共同影響繞組完整性。
knowledge.textEn: Current-related forces and mechanical support jointly affect winding integrity.

knowledge.title: 形變證據
knowledge.text: 內部幾何變化可能需要專門試驗與前後基線比較才能判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Internal geometric change may need dedicated testing and before/after baselines.

quiz.question: 看到油箱外觀完整，能否證明繞組支撐全部正常？
quiz.questionEn: Does an intact tank exterior prove every winding support is sound?
options: 能，外殼會顯示所有內部位移。
能，絕緣材料不可能受到機械影響。
不能，內部狀態仍需相應證據。
optionsEn: Yes; the enclosure reveals every internal displacement.
Yes; insulation cannot be mechanically affected.
No; internal condition still needs appropriate evidence.
quiz.explanation: 不能，內部狀態仍需相應證據。 電流相關作用力與機械支撐共同影響繞組完整性。
quiz.explanationEn: No; internal condition still needs appropriate evidence. Current-related forces and mechanical support jointly affect winding integrity.

steps.title: 規劃乾燥與防再吸濕的交接
steps.titleEn: Plan drying and protection against rewetting
steps.objective: 把乾燥結果與後續暴露控制連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect drying results with subsequent exposure control.
steps.instruction: 畫出主動部件組裝、專業乾燥、封閉轉移及入箱的流程。以兩個假設時程比較乾燥後立即受控交接與長時間不受控暴露，列出需要保留的含水和環境紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Map active-part assembly, professional drying, protected transfer and tanking. Compare controlled handoff with prolonged uncontrolled exposure and list moisture and environmental records to retain.
steps.observation: 乾燥完成時合格，不代表之後仍維持相同含水狀態。
steps.observationEn: Passing at the end of drying does not guarantee unchanged moisture afterward.
steps.failure: 只記乾燥時間而缺少結果與暴露紀錄，不能證明交付狀態。
steps.failureEn: Drying time without outcome and exposure records does not establish the delivered condition.
steps.check: 交接表同時包含乾燥證據、時間線與再吸濕防護。
steps.checkEn: Include drying evidence, timeline and rewetting protection in the handoff record.

knowledge.title: 含水影響
knowledge.text: 水分會影響絕緣性能與老化，因此需要受控處理。
knowledge.textEn: Moisture affects insulation performance and aging and therefore needs controlled handling.

knowledge.title: 狀態保持
knowledge.text: 完成一個製程後，仍需維持其成果直到下一站。
knowledge.textEn: A completed process result must be preserved until the next operation.

quiz.question: 乾燥後長時間暴露且沒有紀錄，能否沿用原先合格結論？
quiz.questionEn: After long unrecorded exposure, can the original drying pass simply be reused?
options: 不能，需要重新確認目前狀態。
能，只要原乾燥設備的設定未改變。
能，乾燥時間已記錄就能代表之後的含水狀態。
optionsEn: No; the present condition needs confirmation.
Yes, if the original dryer settings remain unchanged.
Yes; recorded drying time represents all later moisture conditions.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需要重新確認目前狀態。 水分會影響絕緣性能與老化，因此需要受控處理。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the present condition needs confirmation. Moisture affects insulation performance and aging and therefore needs controlled handling.

steps.title: 整合油箱、密封與冷卻路徑
steps.titleEn: Integrate tank, seals and cooling paths
steps.objective: 辨認絕緣液保存與熱移除的不同功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish insulating-liquid preservation from heat removal.
steps.instruction: 在油箱剖面標出熱源、液體流路、散熱器及對外密封界面。比較通道順暢與局部阻擋的模型，另列出密封證據，避免以「沒有漏油」代替冷卻驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Mark heat sources, liquid paths, radiators and external seals in a tank section. Compare clear and obstructed flow models and list sealing evidence separately from cooling verification.
steps.observation: 密封良好與散熱足夠是不同指標，兩者都不能由外觀單獨證明。
steps.observationEn: Adequate sealing and adequate cooling are different criteria, neither proven by appearance alone.
steps.failure: 把冷卻通道當作可任意填滿的空隙，可能造成熱點。
steps.failureEn: Treating cooling passages as expendable empty space can create hotspots.
steps.check: 熱路徑與密封界面各有獨立檢核，並保留適用的冷卻條件。
steps.checkEn: Give heat paths and seals separate checks and retain applicable cooling conditions.

knowledge.title: 熱路徑
knowledge.text: 繞組損失必須經材料與冷卻系統傳到環境。
knowledge.textEn: Winding heat must pass through materials and cooling systems to the environment.

knowledge.title: 液體保存
knowledge.text: 絕緣液的污染和水分狀態也取決於保存及密封設計。
knowledge.textEn: Contamination and moisture in insulating liquid also depend on preservation and sealing design.

quiz.question: 油箱不漏油，是否足以證明冷卻設計合格？
quiz.questionEn: Does a leak-free tank prove adequate cooling design?
options: 足夠，油量正確便能保證所有局部流路暢通。
不足，熱移除能力還需獨立驗證。
足夠，密封試驗已涵蓋額定熱負載下的表現。
optionsEn: Yes; correct oil quantity guarantees every local flow path is clear.
No; heat-removal capability needs separate verification.
Yes; a seal test covers performance under rated thermal load.
quiz.explanation: 不足，熱移除能力還需獨立驗證。 繞組損失必須經材料與冷卻系統傳到環境。
quiz.explanationEn: No; heat-removal capability needs separate verification. Winding heat must pass through materials and cooling systems to the environment.

stages.title: 附件、試驗與交付
stages.description: 理解不同試驗的證據範圍，保留運輸前後的比較基線。
stages.descriptionEn: Understand the limits of each test and retain pre/post-transport baselines.

steps.title: 核對套管、分接與監測介面
steps.titleEn: Check bushings, taps and monitoring interfaces
steps.objective: 將附件的電氣、機械與監測責任明確分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate electrical, mechanical and monitoring roles of accessories.
steps.instruction: 用系統圖連接套管、繞組分接位置、溫度與油位監測。為每個介面寫出輸入、輸出及應核對文件；區分分接裝置類型，不示範現場切換或帶電操作。
steps.instructionEn: Connect bushings, winding tap positions, temperature and oil-level monitoring in a system diagram. Record inputs, outputs and documents to check, distinguishing tap-device types without demonstrating field switching or live operation.
steps.observation: 附件型號相近也可能有不同電氣等級、安裝界面或操作限制。
steps.observationEn: Similar accessory models can differ in electrical rating, mounting interface or operating limits.
steps.failure: 把所有分接裝置都假定可帶載切換，會造成錯誤操作理解。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every tap device can switch under load creates a dangerous misunderstanding.
steps.check: 介面表包含相容性與操作類型，未知項目不以推測補足。
steps.checkEn: Include compatibility and operating type, leaving unknown items unverified rather than guessed.

knowledge.title: 介面相容性
knowledge.text: 附件需符合主體設計，機械可裝上並不代表電氣相容。
knowledge.textEn: Accessories must match the main design; mechanical fit does not prove electrical compatibility.

knowledge.title: 監測限制
knowledge.text: 監測器提供特定狀態資訊，不能取代所有工廠試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors report particular conditions and do not replace all factory tests.

quiz.question: 兩種分接裝置外觀相似，可否假定操作方式相同？
quiz.questionEn: Two tap devices look similar. Can their operating method be assumed identical?
options: 可以，只要名義變比相同便代表切換條件相同。
可以，機械接口吻合就不需查閱電氣操作類型。
不可，應核對裝置類型與正式規範。
optionsEn: Yes; equal nominal ratio implies equal switching conditions.
Yes; mechanical fit removes the need to check the electrical operating type.
No; verify device type and formal requirements.
quiz.explanation: 不可，應核對裝置類型與正式規範。 附件需符合主體設計，機械可裝上並不代表電氣相容。
quiz.explanationEn: No; verify device type and formal requirements. Accessories must match the main design; mechanical fit does not prove electrical compatibility.

steps.title: 閱讀工廠試驗的不同證據
steps.titleEn: Interpret distinct factory-test evidence
steps.objective: 把變比、損失、阻抗與絕緣試驗對應到不同問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Map ratio, loss, impedance and insulation tests to different questions.
steps.instruction: 使用自製空白試驗報告模板，分別列出變比、繞組電阻、損失、阻抗及絕緣相關試驗的目的。加入一項假設超限結果，選擇應回查的設計或製造紀錄；不搭建高壓試驗回路。
steps.instructionEn: Use an original blank report template to list purposes of ratio, winding resistance, loss, impedance and insulation-related tests. Add a hypothetical out-of-limit result and select records to review without building a high-voltage test circuit.
steps.observation: 通過變比檢查不能替代絕緣或熱性能證據。
steps.observationEn: Passing a ratio check does not replace insulation or thermal evidence.
steps.failure: 跨不同試驗條件比較數字可能產生假異常；先核對條件和單位。
steps.failureEn: Comparing values from different test conditions can create false anomalies; check conditions and units first.
steps.check: 每項試驗都有目的、條件、判據來源及不涵蓋的範圍。
steps.checkEn: Give each test a purpose, conditions, criteria source and excluded scope.

knowledge.title: 試驗分工
knowledge.text: 多種試驗共同驗證不同性能，沒有一個結果代表全部合格。
knowledge.textEn: Different tests verify different properties; no single result proves complete compliance.

knowledge.title: 條件正規化
knowledge.text: 報告需保留溫度、接法與參考條件等解讀必要資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Reports need interpretive context such as temperature, connection and reference conditions.

quiz.question: 變比正確但絕緣證據尚未取得，應如何判定？
quiz.questionEn: Ratio is correct but insulation evidence is missing. What follows?
options: 只能確認已測的變比，整體驗收仍未完成。
變比正確可取代所有介電和熱性能證據。
只要試驗報告有簽名，缺少的項目可視為已完成。
optionsEn: Only the measured ratio is confirmed; overall acceptance is incomplete.
Correct ratio replaces all dielectric and thermal evidence.
A signed report lets missing tests be treated as completed.
quiz.explanation: 只能確認已測的變比，整體驗收仍未完成。 多種試驗共同驗證不同性能，沒有一個結果代表全部合格。
quiz.explanationEn: Only the measured ratio is confirmed; overall acceptance is incomplete. Different tests verify different properties; no single result proves complete compliance.

steps.title: 建立油與絕緣的診斷基線
steps.titleEn: Establish oil and insulation diagnostic baselines
steps.objective: 以趨勢與多項證據判讀，而非單一數字猜測故障。
steps.objectiveEn: Interpret trends and combined evidence rather than diagnose from one number.
steps.instruction: 在紙上報告分開列出水分、介電性質、溶解氣體及相關材料狀態。用兩組假設時間序列比較穩定與變化情境，說明需要哪些運行背景；不實作現場取樣。
steps.instructionEn: Separate moisture, dielectric properties, dissolved gases and material condition in a paper report. Compare two hypothetical time series, stable and changing, and list operating context needed without field sampling.
steps.observation: 相同最終數值可能來自不同歷程，不能忽略趨勢與取樣條件。
steps.observationEn: Identical final values can arise from different histories; trends and sampling conditions matter.
steps.failure: 單一氣體或單次數值不宜被簡化成唯一故障原因。
steps.failureEn: One gas or one reading should not be reduced to a unique fault diagnosis.
steps.check: 判讀說明基線、趨勢、可能原因與追加證據需求。
steps.checkEn: State baseline, trend, possible causes and further evidence needed.

knowledge.title: 條件診斷
knowledge.text: 油與氣體分析可提供內部狀態線索，仍需結合設計與運行資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Oil and gas analysis provide internal-condition clues that still need design and operating context.

knowledge.title: 基線價值
knowledge.text: 初始紀錄讓之後的變化具有比較依據。
knowledge.textEn: Initial records make later changes interpretable.

quiz.question: 兩台設備最終數值相同但變化速度不同，應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: Two units have the same final reading but different rates of change. What should be done?
options: 直接認定兩台狀態完全相同。
結合各自基線、趨勢與運行背景判讀。
只保留最後一筆並刪除時間。
optionsEn: Declare their conditions identical.
Interpret each using its baseline, trend and operating context.
Keep only the last value and delete timestamps.
quiz.explanation: 結合各自基線、趨勢與運行背景判讀。 油與氣體分析可提供內部狀態線索，仍需結合設計與運行資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpret each using its baseline, trend and operating context. Oil and gas analysis provide internal-condition clues that still need design and operating context.

steps.title: 規劃運輸前後的驗證交接
steps.titleEn: Plan verification across transportation
steps.objective: 保存拆卸、運輸及到貨後可比較的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Preserve comparable evidence across disassembly, transport and arrival.
steps.instruction: 畫出工廠驗收、運輸準備、物流交接、到貨檢查與專業再組裝五個狀態。列出每次交接的零件身分、保存條件及基線報告，加入一個運輸異常以決定應暫停哪項後續工作。
steps.instructionEn: Map factory acceptance, transport preparation, logistics handoff, arrival inspection and professional reassembly. Record component identity, preservation and baseline reports, then add a transport anomaly to decide which later work must pause.
steps.observation: 出廠合格不能排除運輸過程中發生的變化。
steps.observationEn: Factory acceptance does not rule out changes during transport.
steps.failure: 忽略異常後直接推進投運，會失去確認狀態的機會；此課程不提供投運操作。
steps.failureEn: Proceeding after an unresolved anomaly loses the chance to verify condition; this course provides no energization procedure.
steps.check: 交接清單可追蹤每項異常、負責人與所需專業複查，保留未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Trace anomalies, responsibility and required professional review while retaining an unreleased status where appropriate.

knowledge.title: 狀態保持與重驗
knowledge.text: 大型設備的運輸與再組裝是品質鏈的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Transportation and reassembly are part of the quality chain for large equipment.

knowledge.title: 證據可比性
knowledge.text: 前後量測需有一致的基準和條件，才能判讀是否改變。
knowledge.textEn: Before-and-after measurements need consistent references and conditions to reveal change.

quiz.question: 運輸紀錄有異常但外觀正常，最佳下一步為何？
quiz.questionEn: Transport records show an anomaly but the exterior looks normal. What is the best next step?
options: 出廠試驗已合格，所以可忽略運輸後的新證據。
只重複外觀檢查，就可排除所有內部變化。
保留異常並依專業程序追加檢查後再決定放行。
optionsEn: Factory acceptance allows new post-transport evidence to be ignored.
Repeating a visual inspection rules out every internal change.
Retain the anomaly and obtain appropriate professional checks before release.
quiz.explanation: 保留異常並依專業程序追加檢查後再決定放行。 大型設備的運輸與再組裝是品質鏈的一部分。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain the anomaly and obtain appropriate professional checks before release. Transportation and reassembly are part of the quality chain for large equipment.

courses.scope: 公開原理的十二項教學任務，以自行繪製的示意模型、試算及來源資料進行；未提供工廠實測資料、專有配方或設備操作許可。 只進行不通電的示意、試算及報告判讀；高壓試驗、起吊、乾燥、充液與投運均須由合格人員依正式程序執行。
courses.scopeEn: Twelve educational tasks based on public principles, using original schematic models, calculations and referenced material. No factory measurement dataset, proprietary recipe or equipment operating authorization is supplied. Uses de-energized diagrams, calculations and report interpretation only; high-voltage tests, lifting, drying, filling and commissioning require qualified personnel and formal procedures.

sources.title: 矽晶圓生產流程
sources.scope: 支援切片、研磨、損傷去除、鏡面拋光與清潔檢查的製程關係；不提供此課程試算的量產設定。
sources.scopeEn: Supports relationships among slicing, lapping, damage removal, mirror polishing and inspection; does not supply production settings for the exercises.

sources.title: 化學機械平坦化
sources.scope: 支援研磨墊、漿料、壓力分布、厚度回授及終點概念；薄膜 CMP 與裸矽晶圓拋光須區別。
sources.scopeEn: Supports pad, slurry, pressure-profile, thickness-feedback and endpoint concepts; film CMP must be distinguished from bare-silicon polishing.

sources.title: SUMCO 公司沿革
sources.scope: 核對 1999 年合資成立及 2002 年事業整合歷史。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the 1999 joint venture and 2002 business integration.

sources.title: SUMCO 公司及工廠據點
sources.scope: 核對伊萬里九州工廠代表據點，不表示所有晶圓在此製造。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies the representative Kyushu factory location in Imari, not an exclusive manufacturing site.

sources.title: 融合與混合接合
sources.scope: 支援介電層預接合、金屬接觸與退火的分工；未提供設備配方。
sources.scopeEn: Supports dielectric prebonding, metal contact and annealing roles, without an equipment recipe.

sources.title: 晶圓混合接合的表面與對位工程
sources.titleEn: Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding: pushing the boundaries to 400nm interconnect pitch
sources.scope: 支援 CMP 凹陷、表面形貌、接墊設計與電性驗證；引用為研究案例，非所有產品規格。
sources.scopeEn: Supports CMP recess, topography, pad design and electrical verification as a research case, not universal product specifications.

sources.title: EV Group 沿革
sources.scope: 核對 1980 年成立及 1999 年面對面晶圓對位技術歷史。
sources.scopeEn: Verifies founding in 1980 and face-to-face wafer-alignment technology in 1999.

sources.title: EV Group 全球據點
sources.scope: 支持奧地利總部代表點與跨國設備供應的背景。
sources.scopeEn: Supports the representative Austrian headquarters and international equipment-supply context.

sources.title: 為何使用消色差透鏡
sources.scope: 支援雙合透鏡、色差修正、共軛方向與剩餘像差的概念。
sources.scopeEn: Supports doublets, chromatic correction, conjugate orientation and residual-aberration concepts.

sources.title: 色差及單色像差
sources.scope: 支援軸向與橫向色差、球差、彗差及場曲的分類。
sources.scopeEn: Supports classification of longitudinal and lateral color, spherical aberration, coma and field curvature.

sources.title: 光學玻璃的折射率與色散
sources.scope: 支援折射率、阿貝數、色散與材料資料判讀；課程數值範例另明確標示為假設。
sources.scopeEn: Supports refractive index, Abbe number, dispersion and glass-data interpretation; exercise values are explicitly hypothetical.

sources.title: Edmund Optics 八十年歷史

place.name: 伊萬里晶圓製造聚落（SUMCO 代表點）
place.nameEn: Imari wafer-manufacturing cluster: SUMCO reference point
place.mapQuery: SUMCO Kyushu Factory, 826-1 Nagahama, Higashiyamashiro-cho, Imari, Saga, Japan

places.summary:
一片可製作晶片的矽晶圓，先需要把材料、幾何及表面狀態控制好。伊萬里是 SUMCO 公開列出的九州工廠所在地之一，可作為認識基板製造與後續晶片製程分工的地理入口。

SUMCO 前身於 1999 年為 300 mm 晶圓開發製造成立合資企業，2002 年整合既有矽晶圓業務。這些是企業歷史節點，不是本課程十二步的量產起點。地圖座標為城市代表位置，地址查詢指向官方列示的工廠；不表示所有晶圓都在此製造，也不表示工廠開放參觀。
places.summaryEn:
A wafer suitable for chipmaking first needs controlled material, geometry and surface condition. Imari hosts a Kyushu factory listed by SUMCO and provides a geographic introduction to the division between substrate manufacturing and later chip fabrication.

SUMCO’s predecessor was formed in 1999 for 300 mm wafer development and manufacturing, and integrated existing wafer businesses in 2002. These are company-history milestones, not the origin of this course’s twelve-step teaching sequence. Coordinates represent the city; the address query points to the officially listed factory. Neither exclusive manufacturing nor public factory access is implied.

place.nameEn: EV Group Austrian headquarters reference point
place.mapQuery: EV Group, DI Erich Thallner Strasse 1, 4782 St. Florian am Inn, Austria

places.summary:
晶圓接合的進步需要材料、對位與設備工程一起發展。EV Group 在奧地利的總部提供一個理解精密設備供應如何支援半導體整合的代表地點。

公司於 1980 年成立，並於 1999 年推出面對面晶圓對位技術 SmartView。歷史強調的是介面可被對準、量測及重複處理的重要性；本課程不將某一公司的設備史當成所有混合接合的唯一來源。座標為城鎮代表點，官方地址供地圖查詢，未聲稱廠区開放參觀。
places.summaryEn:
Progress in wafer bonding combines materials, alignment and equipment engineering. EV Group’s Austrian headquarters is a representative setting for understanding how precision-equipment suppliers support semiconductor integration.

The company was founded in 1980 and introduced SmartView face-to-face wafer alignment in 1999. The history emphasizes interfaces that can be aligned, measured and processed repeatably; it does not make one supplier the sole origin of hybrid bonding. Coordinates represent the town and the official address supports map lookup, without implying public factory access.

places.summary:
消色差透鏡的歷史早於近代光學產業；這裡選擇的是現代精密光學供應與教育的代表點，並非發明地。Edmund Optics 的 Barrington 據點公開列有工程、製造、品保及配送職能，提醒學徒：設計好的光學元件還需要可製造、可測試與可追溯。

Norman Edmund 於 1942 年在 Collingswood 開始販售光學器材，1948 年遷入 Barrington。兩個節點說明光學知識如何透過元件、型錄及工程支援傳播。座標為城鎮代表位置，地圖查詢使用官方地址，不表示每款透鏡都在此生產或可直接入廠。
places.summaryEn:
Achromats predate the modern optics industry. This site represents precision-optics supply and education rather than invention. Edmund Optics lists engineering, manufacturing, quality and distribution functions in Barrington, reminding learners that an optical design also needs manufacturability, testability and traceability.

Norman Edmund began selling optics in Collingswood in 1942, and the business moved to Barrington in 1948. These milestones illustrate dissemination through components, catalogs and engineering support. Coordinates represent the town and map lookup uses the official address; production of every lens and public factory access are not implied.

place.name: NIST Gaithersburg 標準研究園區
place.mapQuery: NIST, 100 Bureau Drive, Gaithersburg, Maryland, USA

places.summary:
安全啟動由多種硬體、韌體、規格與作業系統機制共同組成，不能歸給單一發明地。本課程選 NIST Gaithersburg 園區作為標準研究的代表點，用來理解工程要求如何從保護更新，擴展為保護、偵測與復原的完整思考。

NIST 於 2011 年發布 BIOS 保護指南，2018 年發布平台韌體韌性指南。地圖標示研究園區的概略位置；不是示範伺服器所在地，也不代表所有安全啟動產品在此設計。
places.summaryEn:
Secure boot combines hardware, firmware, specifications and operating-system mechanisms and has no single invention site. This course uses NIST’s Gaithersburg campus as a standards-research reference, showing how engineering requirements extend from protected updates to protection, detection and recovery.

NIST published BIOS Protection Guidelines in 2011 and Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines in 2018. The map marks the approximate research-campus location, not a demonstration-server location or the design site for every Secure Boot product.

history.textEn: SP 800-193 brought platform-firmware protection, corruption detection and trusted recovery into one framework.

當地電機企業 Elektriska Aktiebolaget Magnet 於 1900 年成立，後來納入 ASEA 的產業沿革；2020 年的 120 週年介紹記錄了當地研發與試驗設施背景。早期起源作為近百年發展的前史保留。座標是城市代表位置，不指定某條生產線或公開參觀入口，也不表示所有大型變壓器只在此製造。
places.summaryEn:
Large transformers combine electromagnetics, insulation, manufacturing and high-voltage verification. Ludvika is a power-engineering and research cluster described by Hitachi and illustrates how long-term reliability depends on several disciplines working together.

Elektriska Aktiebolaget Magnet was founded there in 1900 and later became part of ASEA’s industrial history. A 2020 anniversary account described the local research and test context. The early origin provides background to the subsequent century of development. Coordinates represent the city, not a particular production line or public entrance, and do not imply exclusive manufacturing.
